notes.title: Shred & Tear: Oct Dev Blog
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/350e9001f89ae58ff87d0b1ef57b2e68ba550609.png[/img]

A lot has been happening since my last update! As you might already know from the Shred & Tear development roadmap, I've decided to break down the massive main game into four manageable mini-games. This way, I can level up my indie dev skills and gain enough XP before tackling the final boss: the main Shred & Tear game project!

So, the current mini-game in development features one of the core gameplay mechanics of S&T: the infamous Tunnel Race section. A LOT of you shared your frustrations with the Tunnel Race in the S&T prototype demo from 2022. Believe it or not, I've redone the Tunnel Race gameplay from scratch three times now—third time's the charm, right?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/f6f3c65e747f4ca20ec162e500d9b1e6f25b8d4d.gif[/img]

I initially tried making it a QTE (Quick Time Event) game, but it ended up being more boring than easy, let alone enjoyable or challenging. So, here's the third iteration: a mix of fast-paced QTE action and tunnel racing maneuvers. Think of it as a blend of the rail-riding gameplay from Ratchet & Clank and the tunnel sliding from Stella Blade!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/be0a78c52f29d25f351a3e8465f231150e76eb6b.gif[/img]

Guess who the protagonist of the next mini-game is? Nope, not Kajun-chan! cwl It's her sassy, fierce rival - the one and only Shark Girl, Saki-chan! Check out these WIP screencaps of her in the early stages of development.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/dd2610c0b8d7af45eba61c6ec28aee4b4679df99.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/5581ea3f643855ef4804e6ca372406b4961400ca.gif[/img]

I've also made some improvements to the skin shader in the game. Now, you can adjust the "budge" in real-time! Want thigh budges, chest budges, arm budges? You name it! I might have spent a bit too much time playing around with this feature, haha. But trust me, it's going to be super handy during the reward gameplay section in the next mini-game! I am thinking of a massage relax room for Saki-chan where you can massage different part of Saki-chan's bodies!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/d0bad7b9638ede47fb11df16fc6dec4cd2f06691.gif[/img]


While I am at it, I've sprinkled some extra zest onto Saki-chan's body texture and shader. You know what's coming up in the next mini-game's reward module? A massage session for Saki-chan! Yep, after all that hardcore tunnel racing training, she needs to chill out. And where should we start? The armpit, obviously! Now, I haven't found a massage method that specifically targets armpits (yet), but if you've got any ideas, hit me up before Saki-chan decides to end us for tickling her.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/4ea6d93cc45700a06e6b2890d7de84d08a7cff33.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/fada8f9962a8041d0df4730aadc551be9a39c8e0.gif[/img]

Big shoutout to my Discord crew for dropping the gems from Senran Kagura Intimacy Mode. That's some next-level massage inspo right there! Gonna dive deep into that rabbit hole.

Now, onto the meat of our game – the tunnel race! We're in the prototype phase of the chase mechanism. Picture this: you're hot on the heels of that traitorous Tentamon, who's sprinting for his life from your wrath. Maybe next, I'll have him drop bombs or other fun obstacles. Who knows?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/95aab627dee80b63742b5dd00ca0f21b0f14b299.gif[/img]

I've also polished up the spawning sequence. Looks familiar, doesn't it? Yep, big nod to my all-time favorite, the Megaman series. It's got that X spawn vibe, but with our own twist!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/0d381ee3111529644543d762a02c2d8dfbb10681.gif[/img]

And finally, sneak peek at Saki-chan's personal quarters aboard her massive momma spaceship en route to Earth. I'm thinking of calling it the 'Shark Pit' – because why not? She's not at the ship's helm; that's Tentamon's gig. Saki-chan's there to chill, maybe order some snacks, and boss around while keeping an eye on things.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/8dc3a9f454540116366fd220b3eda90233fb988e.gif[/img]

Thanks for being part of this wild ride, and keep those suggestions coming – they're gold!

See you next time !
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/dc100b7d60309c904d6962d4a1f161df4c6cdffd.png[/img]

notes.title: Shred & Tear Development Roadmap!
notes.notes:
[h3][b]✌Hey awesome fellow Men Of Culture![/b][/h3]

✨Thank you so much for your support and interest in my journey to bring our super epic, extra-thick, hotter-than-Sriracha Waifu Hack & Slash game - Shred & Tear, to life!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/f3cf4ad8b916bb3f6faeb4c0ae1c64f95da8afd0.png[/img]

 As you might already know, the main project has been ongoing for more than two years. Most of that time, I've been grinding and learning the ropes of game development. There have been a lot of ups and downs during the development. I released the Prototype Demo in 2022, but scaling it up to the main game has been way more challenging than I anticipated.

😑 Not gonna lie, Shred & Tear is an ambitious project for a near-solo dev like me, but it's not impossible. It just requires careful planning and more experience. Now, with a bit more confidence (thanks, Dunning-Kruger effect), I can finally draft out a viable roadmap for the game! Frankly, it would be a nightmare to spend 4 to 6 years working on my first game only to see it flop upon release. So, I decided to split it into manageable chunks and mini-games, each featuring a core mechanic of Shred & Tear. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2957830/Kajuns_Lucid_Room/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/5dfa9ae12ab7a407a935410ad9d4fa3ccf2d02b7.jpg[/img][/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2957830/Kajuns_Lucid_Room/][h3][b]🍘2024: Kajun's Lucid Room (Released)[/b]:[/h3][/url] This mini-game serves as a proof of concept for the Reward Lobby Room in Shred & Tear. Here, you can view and unlock rewards like 3D models, Kajun's costumes, wallpapers, music, etc. There's a mini-game to earn G-points to unlock items, but in the main game, you'll unlock these items mostly through combat experiences and achievements. This game is free for $5+ tier supporters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/7af3b05d3b2836fa50adefdbb92f6fc9e23c2d19.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]🍘2025: Tunnel Race Mini-Game:[/b][/h3] Remember that infamous tunnel race? It's back as a standalone mini-game! Many people complained about it, so I decided to make it a separate game to test, gather feedback, and polish it. I've revamped the entire tunnel race mechanic from the prototype demo. This mini-game will feature Saki-chan, our Shark Girl, as the playable character. More info will be updated as I work on this second mini-game in the series.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/1ba5e90418796820e006f673783983a6cdeb16f6.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]🍘2025: Combat Core Mini-game:[/b][/h3] This will be the main chunk of Shred & Tear! It's a standalone game with a survival combat type where you'll face waves of enemies and compete to top the leaderboard. Think of it as our Gate of Hell challenge room in Doom Eternal. trophy All kinds of enemies will appear, which will later be integrated into the main game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/7b54408d1d6777dcc8a1fe12f5f4787bdeabb3f4.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]🍘 2026: Boss Challenge DLC:[/b][/h3] This will be a small DLC for the Combat Core game. Boss mechanics are tricky to make interesting and epic, so this will be a separate module.Of course , all of these mini-games are free for patreoners with appropriated tier! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/62c62887053a56c15aa0cc29b7861a941088046e.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]🍘 2027: Shred & Tear Main Game: [/b][/h3]😤 All these mini-games are free for patrons with the appropriate tier! Your support and feedback will help me refine these games and gain the confidence to tackle the main Shred & Tear game. With all core mechanics in place, I'll focus on the story and content to make it a solid experience.

notes.notes:
Hi guys, it's Lucid and I'm back with another episode with It's that saucy time of the month! The 2024 subscription has only started for 1 month and I already want to refund! But well, all things are hard before they are easy, right? I was super busy with the bar and PDD is all out for Lucid Studio. And let's dive right in! 

[h3]Q: PDD! How are things cooking up? 
[/h3]A: Lucid, my girls for Shred&Tear, you guess? I was in the kitchen marinating Lucid Studio Sandbox mode for S&T (and I have been for the whole month). But I'm ready for our little catch up, let's gooooooo! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/c2b88a0b8949b4bb6b8dd2011b415aaf49a40312.png[/img]

[b]Q: Let's go through the highlights of the past month okay? It's about meeee[/b]
PDD: Yes, people has been excitedly looking at your debut on New Year's Eve, Lucid-chan. You're bringing the freshest of Green to the palette! But you know, I think you can also be a hot secretary to our office~ here 's the official art & design of our presentative mascot - Lucid Chan ! with a little Happy New Year Wish to kick off 2024 !

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/6a225ee05c1fd3a09448d248433ebf94747be973.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/e7d0fc57e9c1fd39ecacb5ffaef44a526c0337ae.png[/img]

[h3]Q: I heard you did some revamp to tribute to our people on Patreon too. Right?[/h3]
PDD: I must say, our team has received more than just love along the journey. And that led to the launch of new merchs on Patreon! From shirts to stickers and mugs, there's something for every supporter. And it will be a whole year long of merch! So if you subscribe for more than 3 months then there are various variations of merch to unlock for a Tier!

Plus, for Supreme Sausages and up, we are bringing on the table some hot new spicy NSFW and extra-NSFW version of the  omake Comic. Hope you enjoy! 🎉🌭🎮 (Do you see any sneak peek? hehe)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/f42b0f87d2bbeff2ab7fde2e79dfb4c621865a24.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/b65e6a39ce92a2754d72a322ee95048e280a4147.png[/img]

[h3]Q: That was impressive, I'll ask for a merch with my *gorgeous face* one day! And we cant ignore the entree of this course! Lucid Studioooo
[/h3]PDD: It is steaming hot right now, let me tell you~, let go bit by bit shall we? Buckle up for the grand tour of Lucid Studio, where Kajun-chan and I will be your guides! Our first stop? The Shower section, where you can indulge in some sudsy fun. Ever tried your hand at a minigame where the aim is to rub bubbles as fast as possible? It's quite the challenge, and I might just nickname it a quickie! 🚿💦 You can hop in and see how fast those hands can move! Of course some more "naughty" moves will be added in the up-coming times !

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/f0773b47c0398037297de9b873e7022b2cee52a4.png[/img]

[previewyoutube=8z5-wh0wQK0;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/e7d0fc57e9c1fd39ecacb5ffaef44a526c0337ae.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/01f06865834c37855ac3a966f7804cdb2eebc0fc.png[/img]

[h3]Q: Rather than that, Kajun is definitely a mecha girl, her machines and parts will fall apart after all that bloody battles, where does she do all of that maintenance activity?[/h3]
PDD: Good question! Actually, I have some ideas brewing right now. But first up, let's see the difference it makes when Kajun isn't giving us the death stare. Trust me, it's a whole new world!

[previewyoutube=6z1qlnTk3CY;full][/previewyoutube]

Alright, let's dive into the first idea. Kajun will jog, getting her muscles warm, and we'll have to help her with the "charging", by pressing buttons at the fastest speed possible. She'll get her energy from here to join those fights later!

[previewyoutube=3W5Ix69Aojo;full][/previewyoutube]

Then this second idea, where Kajun can kick back and relax for once, While we are aiming at the same task! She is totally in need of a hand or two *if you know you know*

[h3]Q: Okay what about other "features"? [/h3]
PDD: Okay, let's dive deeper into the wonders hehe. So, apart from jamming out to the OST, which by the way, totally sets the mood, Kajun can also marvel at the 3D models up close and personal. It's like getting a backstage pass to the Shred & Tear world! 🎵🦈 And have you seen Squalomon? It's like they walked straight out of a sci-fi flick!

[previewyoutube=MOBMx5qDFU0;full][/previewyoutube]

Plus, some of you might actually do nothing and just hovering the camera around so I've added a little extra jiggle to her walk. Enjoying the view? 😏

[previewyoutube=Ys2BdMfEJYg;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/a9555b437c3b91b34a32640bc26c4e7cb1d73da8.png[/img]

[h3]Q:Alrighty PDD,  I think everyone might forget about Kajun's little companion at this point, where is he ?[/h3]
PDD: Ah, Gnochi! the little alien tentacle fellow. Can't believe they almost slipped their minds about it. Let me regale you with the tale of this tentacky little fellow once more. So, Gnochi started as a member of the TEABAG army, but soon saw the light and joined the noble cause of the resistance force - GCUP (Guerrilla Comrades & Unification Partisan) and freed Kajun from Tentamon Overlord mind-control influence, following her every move, even here in Lucid Studio. And let me tell you, Gnochi's got a mischievous streak! Always stirring up "trouble" for Kajun-chan. But hey, what's a little chaos between best of friends, right? But don't get it wrong, Gnochi mean no harm to her, they are bonded together in a "special way", that's why they become companions! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/35154e737927df12a24a83d3f36f1a02e755eafe.jpg[/img]

[previewyoutube=pSREVY70088;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Q: I even heard around the bar that Shark Girl is throwing such attitude after being defeated by  Kajun-chan huh? that's funny cause she is kinda reckless?[/h3]
PDD: Alright, gather 'round for some tea time! Let me dish out the details. When it comes to Sharkie, Kajun was anything but gentle! 🦈 Once they step into the ring, rage & temper get the best of them. And let me tell you, even a fierce shark can find itself on the losing end when facing off against a giant crayfish! 🦞 My idea is that Shark-chan can be all super-aggressive & lighting fast of a tiger-shark, but Kajun-chan got the thickness , the true strenght!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/4e17bce8d8473f7006bc8a2a6c153146e64d6598.jpg[/img]

[h3]And Gnochi, that naughty thing would want to mess with Shark-chan too haha, typical Gnochi![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/28c4cf2d0f4bbf560a477525a9cc20858ad8b822.jpg[/img]

[h3]Q: Oh hey Kajun, I heard you do some practice combat with the Sharks lately?[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/e7d0fc57e9c1fd39ecacb5ffaef44a526c0337ae.png[/img]

[h3]You bet! I don't practice, I slay them all the time! [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/38cd92a38459a40c7b35435ebb41135ba4ee6c33.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/6de4e591302741c89960b8b8ce55127b28b346f9.png[/img]

[h3]Q: Shark-chan, My dear, when can we know your badge?[/h3]
Shark Girl: It's best to keep it a secret for now, I love a good surprise hehe *smack*, PDD has opened some official poll on Twitter for voting of my preferable name, but doesnt seem like he got it finalized yet. If I dont like it, I will bite so.... let him take his time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/5bbd885dc0115fc326bb669afc28a1a7e68292d7.png[/img]

And that should be the end of this catching up with the studio so far of what happening in Jan. I'm off to a good shake (of Bloody Mary)!

notes.title: Year 2 Wrap up!
notes.notes:
Greetings, lovely men & ladies of culture! Lucid-chan here 🍸❤️!
Hijacking the dev blog from PDD for a sweet wrap-up of Lucid Realm's rollercoaster year. Buckle up, darlings! Shred & Tear just finished its second year in the oven – challenging, but full of love. It's been a wild ride, never backing down, always adding that secret spice. Here's to more gaming adventures and a sprinkle of magic in the mix! Cheers! Let's get right into it

[h1]💥CHAPTER 1: A YEAR TO A REVAMP TO THE SYSTEM FOR SCALING UP !
[/h1]
[h3]A: How do you feel, ending year 2 already?
[/h3]PDD:  Procrastinating is my middle name... just kidding! lol. Two years in the game-making kitchen, and oh well, it's been a feast. Learned more than I did in college (no offense, professors). Made loads of mistakes – call it our secret sauce ( & pains too ) . Delayed some deadlines, but hey, it's all for that fine dining experience we're cooking up for you players. Stay hungry, stay foolish right? Kajun taste best when it 's done properly. So hopefully I could wrap it up this year 2024!


[h3]A: What have you done most of this year?
[/h3][previewyoutube=r-9i2lc8Kg4;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=r-9i2lc8Kg4[/previewyoutube]

PDD: I've been hard at work fortifying the game's backbone and reinforcing the core system to ensure a seamless experience and scalable gameplay. Picture it like giving our game a sturdy exoskeleton – less bugs more fancy skills and gameplay, and of course - compatibility across various platforms and devices. I've delving deep into Unreal Engine wizardry, optimizing the visuals, and fine-tuning the structure & architect so it can handle various aspect of the gameplay from damage handling, moveset design to AI behaviors . It's not just a game; it's a full course fine dining experience, and I got to  ensuring every dish is served carefully and harmony. With the scale up of Shred & Tear's world, i'm doubling down to maintain stability as we still have new levels, gameplay type and experiences. It's like crafting the perfect recipe; each ingredient matters for the overall flavor.
[previewyoutube=MpEB-89tzAo;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MpEB-89tzAo[/previewyoutube]
Oh and the most complex system I have been working on in 2023 is the way Kajun gonna "gory-kill" those poor Tentamons, making these sweet eye-candy QTE blend seamlessly with gameplay.

[h3]A: We have quite a lot of new attacks, can you list your top 3 this year?
[/h3]PDD: If I had to pick my top three moves, they'd all be the jaw-dropping Gory Kills.
First up, the Tentamon Gory Kill – it's like a dark, twisted rendition of that famous "Dumb Ways to Die" episode where eyes end up as juice. 
[previewyoutube=KLMxFWAvYks;full][/previewyoutube]


Then, there's the Squalomon Gory Kill – you know the saying "break a leg"? Well, she literally did it. 
[previewyoutube=NmkzkthcF6U;full][/previewyoutube]

Lastly, the Salumon Gory Kill – Kajun's got a knack for breaking things, and this one's a masterpiece in mayhem. It's like turning chaos into an art form.
[previewyoutube=5bVkmrg4TCc;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]A: What do you focus mostly on during the revamp of all the enemies of Lucid Realm?
[/h3]PDD: Initially, I thought about making those tentacle monsters cute – you know, the kind you might find in a quirky anime or cheesy cartoon . But then, I felt the urge to turn up the intensity with more gore and cysts. It just made sense; Kajun needed enemies that matched her intensity. The juxtaposition of the grotesque against a fiery mecha girl adds that extra layer of challenge. Some say they are too cute to kill, so I gotta make them into the "hideous" realm. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/b4ac7b95c7f7e16ece9dd87de1cc559c4c2a7f6a.png[/img]

And let's talk bosses – whether it's the Witch, Shark Girl, Overlord, or the big bad boys Salumon & Squalomon, they're all rocking the badass vibe. It's like assembling an all-star team of formidable foes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/5af4a9cfd16b0352001e984759486d3cfabe6e58.png[/img]
The Millennium Witch

[previewyoutube=I1SvooIPskk;full][/previewyoutube]
Salumon

[previewyoutube=n5gYB6iUjDM;full][/previewyoutube]
Squalomon

[h1]💥CHAPTER 2: A NEW ERA OF VILLAIN (Featuring Shark Girl)[/h1]
[h3]A: Sharkieeeeeee
[/h3]Shark Girl (SG): Stop that, it sounds like "shake it"! My official name badge is NOT suppose to be revealed YET. So keep Quiet !
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/5314ce902e24525aa827d97e430aa763c3246895.png[/img]


[h3]A: Alright, no more jokes. Are you surprised with the love & support so far?
[/h3]SG: Suprised ? Nooo, I have the pretty privileges, used to it for YEARS, thousands of them. Femme fatale flows in me. I have no doubt that my followers (mainly Tentamons and Squalomons) always admire me and shower me with all the love they have as if their lives depend on it.( literally ) . But I NEED MORE !!!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/15f2e18908f571e002c0817874d3b0ce43d08978.png[/img]


[h3]A: What is your favourite part of being a shark-base MERC?
[/h3]SG: I can end lives on a daily basis, even without the equipped armor. My sharp teeth really make it really easy to chew things ! *sending love hickey to all my supporters!!!*. But my armor is really what makes things spicy. Look at those laser blades!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/922e21742e3fd3fcd0e20d18a2e81140fc5c977c.png[/img]
PDD: add note*: well Shark-chan design is not based on a regular shark, but a tiger shark to be precise. That's why she has the blades design.

[h3]A: One last question, what's your favourite dishes Shark-chan?
[/h3]SG: Fresh Crawfish of course, with cajun sauce *smirk*. I gonna crush that little Kajun like a lollipop.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/4ba01c6d5e903455c9c9eaa0b649abdcadfaae80.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/e7d0fc57e9c1fd39ecacb5ffaef44a526c0337ae.png[/img]
[h3]Bring it ON!
[/h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/a9555b437c3b91b34a32640bc26c4e7cb1d73da8.png[/img]


[h1]💥CHAPTER 3 - UPCOMING PLAN FOR S&T (back with our PDD)
[/h1]
[h3]A: What do you have in mind for the new year 2024?
[/h3]PDD: My New Year's resolution? Well, it's not fullHD, that's for sure, I just bought myself a 4k monitor just for coding. Oh you mean New Year plan right ? I'm aiming to turbocharge my programming skills and Game Design architecture stuff . It's time for some finesse in the gameplay and mechanics. Because let's face it, no one likes a game that's as glitchy as my morning coffee maker and as frustrated as my Piano teacher teaching me.  I have almost done the core system so what 's left is the level design and content populating, I'm trying to Release the FINAL GAME within this year,(cry of a perfectionist) !!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/e7d0fc57e9c1fd39ecacb5ffaef44a526c0337ae.png[/img]
[h3]I can't wait to jump in and shred those Tentamon again in full scale! [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/5a95968ad57b617f7a3e5526476bf4375a117565.png[/img]


[h3]A: What will be introduced specifically *eagerly nods* - Is it what im looking for?
[/h3]PDD: How can I forget haha, just want to see if you remember ;). Lucid Studio mode is about to be served on your plate, and it's a small sand-box mode as a small gift for our beloved supporters to play with our Kajun-chan while waiting for the main course. Picture this - a small, relaxing sandbox mode where Kajun kicks back, unwinds, and has an absolute blast. I might sprinkle in a few extra goodies down the line, but let's keep the main course focused on Shred & Tear. Lucid Studio is like a delightful side dish, perfectly complementing the main gaming feast. So get ready for a taste of both worlds!


[previewyoutube=JPXura1YhHY;full][/previewyoutube]
You can do some maintenance works with Kajun-chan in this mode !

[previewyoutube=8z5-wh0wQK0;full][/previewyoutube]
Or even scrubbing blood stains off Kajun-suit after battles ! ( well given you havent take the suit off have you ? ) 

[previewyoutube=1sfqUTU-ZLc;full][/previewyoutube]
Or you can just sit back and enjoy the full OST of Shred&Tear.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/e7d0fc57e9c1fd39ecacb5ffaef44a526c0337ae.png[/img]
[h3]A taste of personal me! [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/5a95968ad57b617f7a3e5526476bf4375a117565.png[/img]

[h1]💥CHAPTER 4: OUR FRIENDS & ACHIEVEMENTS!
[/h1]
[h3]A: Who joined hands with you this year to build Lucid Realm? 
[/h3]PDD: Good old folks! 
It's Lily, my full-stack assistant (she is doing both the front & back office work!). 
Shady and his lewd kart, have been such a great support system for my game. 
Ohara-san, the artist doing the base works for all our Omake-comic so far ! 
Lucas Tuttle - the composer behind the badass Music of Shred & Tear.
Ribbonizer - our beloved dedicated mod!
And you *pointing to the camera* my beloved supporters, ladies and men of culture!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/e7d0fc57e9c1fd39ecacb5ffaef44a526c0337ae.png[/img]
And you don't even thank me? You can't spell awesome without ME you know?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/f7ac1829671421884aa50684f9773743752f63bd.png[/img]

[h3]A: Let's go through the numbers, shall we?
[/h3]PDD: Why not, let's go!

We gained 637204 impressions on the Steam storefront, and a total of 113,064 visits!
Total wishlist at this point of Dec 31 - 38,000 - A HUGE NUMBER for an indie game like us - thank you so so much!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/511436c7c37d3490f04a7877adf169a1619acd5c.jpg[/img]

And out of that 38000 wishlists, there are 275 people who decided to support us on Patreon. How good is that? Honestly, I didn't know what I did to get this much love!

That's our year two wrap! Looking forward to the journey with you guys~
-Lucid-chan <3

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/a1f39c9c1800d4de4d375b511510bb150ce31532.png[/img]

notes.title: It's saucy time #17
notes.notes:
[h1]It’s saucy time #17
＼＼\\٩( 'ω' )و //／／[/h1]

It’s Lucid Chan. And it’s been a while since we have some updates! I will be the host and taking Lucid Realm’s updates from now on. Even though the holidays are coming, our bar will have a lot to do. I’ll be asking questions for everyone, including PDD & Kajun, and possibly anyone?

[h1]Current State of Shred & Tear
[/h1]
[h3]Q: So, spill the beans, what's the Shred & Tear squad cooking up this month?[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/b444eec58db387e35160c73d8f1cf0135c9d26b9.jpg[/img]
[i]Kajun admiring her little trophies[/i]

PDD: We're putting the spotlight on Lucid Studio, our bite-sized standalone treat. Supporters can get the taste of extra game goodness while we're working on the main feast. Right now, it's like we're throwing a small chilling get-together with Kajun, no boss, and simple “cultured” fun, you know? As for the main game itself, we're cranking up the volume—more enemies, more complex skills & systems in the recipe. Thus we're giving the whole base system structure a makeover so it can handle the heat when we scale up. Stay tuned for the Kajun explosion * insert evil laugh *!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/652a1801e5f1c1f95fcc2a45d8c0b70701ed6a99.gif[/img]


[h3]Q: So....Tokyo Game Show last September—how was it rubbing shoulders with the bigwigs? Any impressed faces? [/h3]
PDD: Oh, you bet! Met up with the crew from DLsite, and they were all buzzing with excitement. We're even cooking up plans for some explicit content releases on DLsite—still in the brainstorming phase. I am still not sure what exactly and how spicy it would be when we are on DLSite, so platform variations are like secret ingredients; we're keeping them under wraps until we're closer to the grand unveiling. Stay tuned!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/e7d0fc57e9c1fd39ecacb5ffaef44a526c0337ae.png[/img]
[h3]mOrE NSFW? PDD you MUST consult this with me before doing anything with 'em![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/f7ac1829671421884aa50684f9773743752f63bd.png[/img]

[h3]Q: Many have asked about Lucid Studio mode, where… Kajun does… fun stuff. Can you spoil anything? What can we watch? Like we wanna know!![/h3]

PDD: Oh, it's a feast for the eyes! We're diving deep into all the models of S&T, enemies, and bosses, giving you a sneak peek on a model shelf. And yes, brace yourself, Kajun's up to some saucy (16+) action—think about controlling her during a relaxing bath, you want Kajun to rub where you want her to ?. Any wild suggestions from your end?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/ed089afe9a3f99e8aa2a821831e342298d67ac4d.jpg[/img]
[i]Just chilling[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/414d3f06a297cf7932744f352ec84011cb4cc4d0.jpg[/img]
[i]or maybe take a closer look at the enemy to f them up later
[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/e7d0fc57e9c1fd39ecacb5ffaef44a526c0337ae.png[/img]
[h3]PDD, I kill I don't hang around making jokes *claws up*[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/cae5c955a2dc01adeb8ea4cdaf91c552611a5097.png[/img]

[h3]Q: We knew Shark Girl already, but can you tell us more about her? Like was she close to others bosses? [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/07d74ad992e017c55d73063ce13ba79666af8f99.png[/img]

PDD: Ah, the Shark Girl—she's Salumon's boss. Salumon gave her the lowdown: head to Earth, pick out and assimilate the best MERC around (that's Kajun-chan). As the deadline looms, Shark Girl swoops in to validate the final results. Personality-wise, not much intel, but picture a gladiator-style, brutal manager. Oh, and her direct underling is none other than the Mercy Shark (Squalomon - the mecha shark monster one). It's a deep-sea managerial hierarchy, you could say. Check out this month’s Omake Comic on our Patreon, it’s what happens when you fail the deadline with Shark Girl.

[h3]Q: We’ve also seen Overlord Boss with those gigantic mecha tentacles. Do you think it’s too big for her? (i mean in size). By the way how old might it be?[/h3]

[previewyoutube=nVend6OLsrk;full][/previewyoutube]

PDD: Ah, the Overlord Boss, a bit tight-lipped on its role for now, but brace yourself for a colossal encounter down the road in Kajun's journey. As for its age... well, let's keep that under wraps for now. The mystery adds to the thrill, right?

[h3]Q: Squalomon kill is really brutal, but will there be too many of them?[/h3]

[previewyoutube=UOLSh9-wKPc;full][/previewyoutube]

PDD: Every enemy gets their final dance with Kajun, a gory kill moment. Now, Squalomon is a special case; it's got not one, but two gory kills. Picture this: Kajun, surrounded by a swarm of sharks. Variety is the spice of life, right? Gotta keep things interesting. I want Kajun to be able to kill them in as many brutal ways as possible but well, my budget for animators has its limit ( cry* ) 

[previewyoutube=NmkzkthcF6U;full][/previewyoutube]


[h3]Q: What is the main difference between the first and second prototype of Blood bomb? How does the attack work?[/h3]

[previewyoutube=RrRZnOvqnew;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]First version[/i]

PDD: We've refined the Blood Bomb in version 2, adding more polish to the messy, gooey, and gory aftermath it leaves on the ground. It's not just ground-bound; the Blood Bomb explodes in the air or upon impact if it's airborne for too long—think of it like a grenade. The concept here is Tentamon being treated like spoiled food, exploding into a gooey temperature, and Kajun becoming a mobile microwave of destruction. Imagine Kajun heating up the poor guy using her hand‘s Heat Wave and throwing the hot-explosive-at-any-moment dumplings at you.

[previewyoutube=vm38A6aFGSo;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]Refined version[/i]

[h3]Q: How big does the impact area of the projectiles attack? Is it even bigger than blood bomb?[/h3]
PDD: It would be boring if Kajun could only eliminate enemies up close with her claws. Hence, we've introduced various ranged attacks, including projectile and bullet-based assaults. These provide a longer range but come with potentially weaker damage and increased difficulty in aiming compared to the Blood Bomb.

[previewyoutube=--L33IPa43s;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Q: Who is your main inspiration while making the OST for Shred & Tear?[/h3]

[previewyoutube=eMWaTaWj4zc;full][/previewyoutube]

PDD: The inspiration for the soundtrack comes from artists like TeddyLoid, BossFight, and Demetori, particularly the arrangements of Touhou Final Bosses track. This music will be prominently featured in the tunnel raid section. While we already have a track in the demo, this new one is designed to be even faster and more brutal, though not as frustrating, so rest assured.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/e7d0fc57e9c1fd39ecacb5ffaef44a526c0337ae.png[/img]
I like this one from BossFight! 
[previewyoutube=57c94il3Eng;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/5a95968ad57b617f7a3e5526476bf4375a117565.png[/img]


[h1]Seasonal Art & Omake[/h1]
[h3]Q: So… last year Kajun dressed up as 2B. And this year, a 3-head mecha waifu, does she share anything with you?[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/ce54217ed3148c0c1bbce078dedfcc7d37c48e89.png[/img]

PDD: Yeah! She mentioned she doesn't like tight clothes. I've been trying to keep Kajun trendy with different Halloween costumes every year. Can you guess where this year's idea came from? (Hint: it's from a TikTok video.)

[h3]Q: Personally, can you choose? Which one is your favourite among Shark girl, Millennial Witch or Overlord Boss? (I personally gotta choose Overlord cause it’s big)[/h3]
PDD: I am all over for the girls. But honestly, we gotta focus more on the Witch later on since she doesn't have much story/reveal info about her (yet).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/e4f2080d5617c09b7e62df8c5290883084b1bc75.png[/img]

[h3]Q: Have you ever planned for Shark Girl to win? Cause you know, every villain has their story? (and a lot of fan requests)[/h3]
PDD: Oh, the eternal struggle of villains and heroes, right? Well, every boss has its day, but let me tell you, Kajun's got some surprises up her sleeve and bosses are destined to be defeated. Now, whether Shark Girl gets a victory dance or not, that's a secret worth unlocking. But hey, it's not the ending you'd expect! Dive into this month's Patreon rewards for the juicy details. Don't miss out, it's gonna be fin-tastic! 🦈😄

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/e8fd7913ae7636bd6934692d232c37daebc63f81.png[/img]


[h3]Q: These two are quite naughty, do they fight alot? I hope not cause I wanna see them together more often hehe.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/4ba01c6d5e903455c9c9eaa0b649abdcadfaae80.jpg[/img]

PDD: Oh, it's like hearing nonstop quarrels around them! Everyone's a bit wary of Kajun's temper, but you know, Shark Girl, she's a bit of a tease, and she is not afraid at all. No backing down from a re-fight with Kajun though, they've got that dynamic duo charm. It's like a quirky sitcom, but with more claws and fins! 😄


[h3]Q: The new Patreon T-shirt is NSFW PDD! Where can we possibly show her off? [/h3]

notes.title: Dev Blog 014: refining Game Core Gameplays
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/df817fd6b27edb5fccb940083292c547db59debb.png[/img]

[h1]＼＼\\٩( 'ω' )و //／／
Greetings, men of culture (and ladies)![/h1]

It's PDD back with some news about our upcoming game, Shred & Tear. Before we dive in, I hope you've all been keeping well and maybe even trying out some new cooking skills in the kitchen. I've been experimenting with some new recipes myself, and it's been a nice change of pace from the intense game development process.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/c2b88a0b8949b4bb6b8dd2011b415aaf49a40312.png[/img]
[h2]Official Demo reschedule … but ![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/7f38f243843c13f689e7b8f72b2b08a70add13e3.png[/img]

Now, onto the news. I really want to apologize for the delay in the release of our official demo. We had planned to launch it in March, but as you know, game development can be unpredictable. We want to ensure the game is polished to perfection before releasing it to our valued players. The demo has been moved to Q3/2023, but in the meantime, we have a special treat planned for you. Stay tuned for an invitation-only, private event that we'll be announcing in April. It's going to be a blast!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/e7d0fc57e9c1fd39ecacb5ffaef44a526c0337ae.png[/img]
[h3]YOU'D BETTER MAKE SURE THINGZ GOT PREPARED IN TIME PDD![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/a9555b437c3b91b34a32640bc26c4e7cb1d73da8.png[/img]


[h2]A cultured achievement[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/a502e14613022ddb3a4a6799dd2f2d86925276ad.png[/img]

On a positive note, we recently hit a milestone of 6969 followers on social media, and over 32000 wishlists on Steam. We're thrilled to see so many gamers eagerly anticipating the release of Shred & Tear. We also have 33 monthly support patrons, who we're incredibly grateful for. And of course, a big thank you to our talented team who has been working tirelessly to bring this game to life.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/b65e6a39ce92a2754d72a322ee95048e280a4147.png[/img]
[h2]Option Menu with Custom Control Mapping[/h2]

[previewyoutube=O4FdkS7pQag;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/54bfd14259e5e2868f5ef260fe4e80cecb0926f2.png[/img]
[i]Customize Camera Shake - 4 levels: “Smooth as Silk”, “Just right”, “Let’s shake”, “Shake your brain out!”[/i]

Now, let's talk about some exciting new features we've been cooking up. We've added a custom control mapping option to the game's menu, so you can adjust settings like camera shake, FOV, armor type, and difficulty level to your liking. It's like creating your own personal recipe for the perfect gaming experience. Personally, I like to play with no armor, just the right amount of camera shake, and the highest difficulty level. But, just like in cooking, everyone has their own unique tastes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/f7322537cd6938b1404a1e977c8010f80519a50c.png[/img]
[i]Customize Difficulty - 4 levels: “One Hand Man”, “Average Enjoyer”, “I like it rough!”, “Call Me Crazy”[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/e7d0fc57e9c1fd39ecacb5ffaef44a526c0337ae.png[/img]
[h3]No Armor with "right amount" of "shake"? anyone ?  [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/f7ac1829671421884aa50684f9773743752f63bd.png[/img]

[h2]Gory Kill early prototype test[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/85415b5bcb3857ad837a8c331e998b88fb603043.gif[/img]
[i]you don't want to be shredded, trust me[/i]

[previewyoutube=KLMxFWAvYks;full][/previewyoutube]

Speaking of unique tastes, we've been testing out a new "gory kill" feature that involves adding bloody minced meat everywhere. It's not for the faint of heart, but for those who enjoy a little extra spice in their games, it's sure to satisfy. Kajun-chan looks like she's making alien meatballs, and it's both gruesome and hilarious at the same time.

[previewyoutube=eIMiFT8Y18c;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Seasonal Artwork[/h1]
[h2]A new wallpaper for your spicy PC setup[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/3fda2d0cd5b46b0be0685bceccfd8176841fe1b2.png[/img]

For those of you who love to deck out your PC setup, we have a brand new Kajun-chan wallpaper available. She felt like she'd been a little too cute recently, so she wanted to show off her rage in this new design.

[h2]Omake[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/f7f120ed7f6e033f8820243b5cab657a23004a46.png[/img]

Kajun-chan was known as the "chosen one" with an unparalleled level of aggression. However, she soon realized that she couldn't defeat machines unless she became one herself. Tentamon had a plan to transform Kajun-chan into the ultimate weapon, powerful enough to help them conquer Earth. But little did they know, their plan would be a double-edged sword. Kajun-chan was not one to be tamed easily and things did not turn out in their favor. I’m proud to say she’s on our side!

And the rest is history (and is also on our [url=https://www.patreon.com/LucidRealmGames]Patreon[/url])
[url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/public-march-2-80115638?utm_medium=clipboard_copy&utm_source=copyLink&utm_campaign=postshare_creator&utm_content=join_link]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/0a49c4c3696b5554c594eb132c49a213a6444d0f.png[/img][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/6de4e591302741c89960b8b8ce55127b28b346f9.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/82e3e566fcf86d08c99b67c0f95244a49fc1195c.png[/img]

Now, I know there's been some talk about AI boycotts lately, but I'm not worried. I'll keep making my signature trademark of mecha waifu, and you guys can keep enjoying it. And speaking of enjoying things, we recently saw a fan cosplay of Kajun-chan in a red robot outfit, and it looked amazing! I love seeing how creative you guys can get. (From @Sxdoll3000)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/4103dd359ba37c46e888384aeda62c823ffeac68.png[/img]

[h2]And the winner... is Kajun-chan... (obviously)[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/224a933bd8e476c912fedae07cd96b92528f1700.png[/img]

We threw some polls an honestly I would expect someone else... Just kidding, but Kajun will shred me if she doesn't win, for real. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/55724a9422684251b5919d836dec6a339af154fc.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/e7d0fc57e9c1fd39ecacb5ffaef44a526c0337ae.png[/img]
[h3]Now you'd better tell me who do you think could possibly win this PDD?[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/a9555b437c3b91b34a32640bc26c4e7cb1d73da8.png[/img]

[h3]Again! We're really sorry for the demo delay, but we promise it'll be worth the wait. We've got some exciting things in store for you, so keep supporting us and keep being the awesome gamers that you are. Until next time, keep on shredding and tearing![/h3]

[h1]________________________

From PDD - Dark Lord of Lewd[/h1]

I also heard you were complaining about our Tentamons being "too cute." Well, you'll be pleased to know that I’ve given them a complete makeover. Tentamons now sports a gory and rotten style that's sure to give you nightmares. Get ready to be terrified by this once-adorable minion-like creature. Remember that olive pack that you left untouched for years in the fridge? Yeah, he’s evolved *wink*

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/b4ac7b95c7f7e16ece9dd87de1cc559c4c2a7f6a.png[/img]

[h2] New Skill: Blood Bomb [/h2]

[previewyoutube=RrRZnOvqnew;full][/previewyoutube]

Our girl has a deadly new move up her sleeve, capable of grabbing a Tentamon, heating it up, and then launching it into a wall for a fiery explosion. Originally intended to be called the "Blood Bomb," I think it needs a cooler name. Any suggestions? This move is not for the faint of heart, and it's sure to leave the Tentamon troop reeling. You should be careful not to get on Kajun-chan's bad side too. Or you might just become the next victim of her explosive attacks 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/e7d0fc57e9c1fd39ecacb5ffaef44a526c0337ae.png[/img]
Anyone want to be grabbed by me? Rest assured, I gonna do it quick!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/38cd92a38459a40c7b35435ebb41135ba4ee6c33.png[/img]

[h2]New Skill: Spike missiles [/h2]

[previewyoutube=RrRZnOvqnew;full][/previewyoutube]

Remember those wings on Kajun's back? they are not just for show. When activated, Kajun-chan can launches these blades and releasing a barrage of explosive energy that engulfs all enemies within the designated range. But do you think this is too much? I might have to nerf this around though while still keeping the fun and aggressive gameplay. Any suggestions are welcomed!

That’s all for today’s update y’all, let me know in the comment what you think!

notes.title: It’s saucy time #12 - Year One wrapup
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Greetings, men of culture (and ladies)![/b][/h1]

Lucid Realm first opened its portal to the public exactly one year ago. To me, this has been a tremendous milestone that I’ve been working towards for basically my whole life, and it’s hardly an exaggeration since this Realm, this dream of mine, has been stewing on the fire since I began to truly know myself. A boy who loved video games and draw anime, a 3D Animator who drew his way to college, a young artist who entered the world of game production with all of his passion, an entrepreneur who started at something he loved - all of them have converged into who I am today. an Indie Game Developer with a little bit of "cultured" spice !  

But this was not a journey I undertook alone. It’s always great to see a vision become a reality, but it is much greater still to be able to share it with so many people. Many of you have known me for quite a while, and some have only become acquainted with me just recently, but we all share the same tastes and vision: absolute adoration of beautiful, sexy, and badass ladies of war. There’s more than meets the eye about them. They are not just there to be eye candy but are also formidable warriors who can take over the entire world if given a chance! Sexiness & badass does blend well !

Now, if you will follow me on a quick trip down memory lane to where things started and how we got to this point.

Even though the word “Realm” has a sense of scale and longevity to it, I would still call this whole journey a marathon. It sure took me a tremendous amount of time to prepare for the run, and yet, I’m still at the very beginning of it. There’re many goals to hit, and there is a destination. 

[h3]not-so-random Fact #1: I am a determined & cautioned person. So I prefer everything is just going slowly but really steady around me most of the time[/h3]

[h1]Phase 1: The preparation[/h1]

In 2022, after 15 years, I finally felt “that” moment coming. I was ready for the new challenges. I found my own "little game studio" and start working on my first personal game project. It all started with a code name, loads of brainstorming sessions, and I got a protagonist on the table. She was mad sexy. She had everything it took to take over the world, but she decided to save it. She is Kajun-chan.

This is the first ref collection/mood board that I used to create Kajun’s appearance sometime in 2021
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/576afa1534c972691d347550739ec9df25bbd194.jpg[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/e7d0fc57e9c1fd39ecacb5ffaef44a526c0337ae.png[/img]
[h3]Never-released-before Fact #2: Kajun-chan working title was “Godzi-chan”, though it didn’t have a nice ring to it, and it didn’t sound very fitting for a character of this power level.[/h3]
So can you guess what the current name is coming from ? 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/01f06865834c37855ac3a966f7804cdb2eebc0fc.png[/img]

[h2]December 2021 - A little Realm emerge! [/h2]

I published the Steam Front Page and started a new [url=https://twitter.com/LucidRealmGames]Twitter account for Lucid Realm[/url]. Things were going quite well since I had my audiences & supporters already from my[url=https://twitter.com/phungdinhdung] main Twitter Account[/url]. And some, up until this day, are still in the Discord server. I can’t thank them enough. Honestly, really, I can't really go on without knowing that there are people out there appreciate and take a liking to my creations !
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/37fa0bc750db41b4720bf624dbb9d0fd2290797b.png[/img]

[h3]Never-released-before Fact #3:  I know my whole style is all about lewdness and sexy badass, which is quite niched when it come to target audiences. Surprisingly, in steading of giving me the judgement, there are quite a lot of ladies supporting the project! Ladies, if you truly root/love for something please casting aside the common prejudice and speak up ! #womeningaming[/h3]
oh I guess the same standpoint would be valid for guys as well...

[h2]January 2022 - The first Dev Blog[/h2]

Have you seen Kajun’s first two teasers? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/f04a89a2ac3e5a5f81f4e70770ef8349648268f4.gif[/img]

There are many who would wonder why I intended for Kajun to be the one and only protagonist of Shred & Tear’s first act. And those who follow my work will know that I have literal a design collections of badass, sexy ladies which can be picked out and ready to serve instantly in a project like this. But to really think about it, who would be the best contender to fight Kajun for that spotlight? I just want a world that only has single finest girl fighting against endless waves of grotesque monsters, that's the beauty of it. When it comes to fine-dining, quality matter not quantity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/fe8662a1fd685c62ecbc31f88e2b0967f07f5abe.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/e7d0fc57e9c1fd39ecacb5ffaef44a526c0337ae.png[/img]
[h3]Never-released-before Fact #4: Well actually, there is one, but you dont get to control/play her *ahem* . I’ll let you guess. You probably seen her already *wink*[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/38cd92a38459a40c7b35435ebb41135ba4ee6c33.png[/img]
[h2]February 2022 - Details on the Realm[/h2]

This month alone, I published 12 materials in every aspect of the game. From Kajun-chan’s model to some of the enemies and bosses. The early WIP quality of the work really shows, especially compared to how things are now, but people were still excited about their potential. If you’ve been here since those rough early days, you’re OG, and I salute you!

Tentamon, Squalomon & Salumon

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans//41522540/62edefc30db458cb7bd9540814751daa079d120d.jpg[/img]

[previewyoutube=I1SvooIPskk;full][/previewyoutube]

[previewyoutube=INnqbhjKA2E;full][/previewyoutube]

Now, you must have seen this in the demo, right? xD

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/e7d0fc57e9c1fd39ecacb5ffaef44a526c0337ae.png[/img]
[h3]I-released-this-one-but-you-might-not-noticed fact #5: Salumon’s name originates from the Italian charcuterie board - Salumi. yum.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/5a95968ad57b617f7a3e5526476bf4375a117565.png[/img]


[h2]March 2022 - Little bit dev on story setup, what happened to Earth?[/h2]

I’ve uploaded a rough storyboard of the prequel comic around this time, but, another fact #5: i bet you’ve never seen the first few sketches

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/598c1ceca2623df046f218fc67b9078f1789c5ed.png[/img]

The soundtrack also materialized around this point. The music is meant to convey that “chiptune 90s gaming x mecha waifu in a rock band” kind of mood. I’ve worked very hard with the composer ([url=https://www.lucastuttle.com/]shout out to Lucas Tuttle[/url]) on these tracks. 

[previewyoutube=Tuw-qaeJlHo;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/e7d0fc57e9c1fd39ecacb5ffaef44a526c0337ae.png[/img]
[h3]Never-released-before fact #6: Lucas already working on series of main soundtracks for the next update! which is even more metal and badass sounding! [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/cae5c955a2dc01adeb8ea4cdaf91c552611a5097.png[/img]


[h2]April 2022 - Shady got our back![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/e96dbde8cbb4099decec7474c891c0dafa34bcc5.png[/img]
We shook hands with a publisher! And since then, Shady Corner Games has been our best friend on this journey. This is me rating my top three games published under Shady’s shade. Highly NOT recommended when you are in public, because you might blush way too much.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1622110/Zoria_and_the_Cursed_Land/]Zoria and the Cursed Land[/url]: Who will be against an Orc sexy cutie pie anyway? Plus it’s pixel NSFW *dive the hell in*
[url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/achivements-of-75306636]Under-the-witch[/url]: Visuals!!!! And holy customization, my people!!!
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1630420/Slime_Girl_Smoothies/]Slime Girl Smoothies[/url]: Cannot unsee this game. I started looking at my um.. fruit… a little differently…

If you’re a fan of sexy & lewdness, make sure to check these out too! 

[h3]You-might-not-know fact #7: I made alot of rookies mistakes as an indie Game Dev, but Shady Corner did help me alot and providing me useful insight throughout the whole journey[/h3]

[h1]Phase 2: Get it out there[/h1]

[h2]May 2022 - 3P, but not what you think[/h2]

It was our Private Playtest Party. The first prototype was “sort of” ready, but not quite entirely. So I decided to let a few of my Discord members try it first. As anxious as I was, it was also exciting to receive feedback from others. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/e7d0fc57e9c1fd39ecacb5ffaef44a526c0337ae.png[/img]
[h3]Never-released-before fact #8: A weird bug that my testers stumbled across: Duplicate Waifus!![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/f7ac1829671421884aa50684f9773743752f63bd.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/f9bbbcadc7686b85559dd434c6ede17e3d876b88.png[/img]

[h2]June 2022 - The first prototype release[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/d5162a8d7e75cd41f5e657cd073a99e7c7411860.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/f75372ccaf61aaf416a6897ee1987c649d73789b.png[/img]
The prototype finally went live, and the level of support it received was astounding! 

- Discord members: Started at around double digits in April, by the beginning of June, the ranks swelled to 1K. And by the end of it? 1.5K. It still wasn’t by any means a terribly huge community, but it was a quality close circle.
- Wishlist: I saw a really gradual growth for the first quarter, but dear, Steam did their magic for indie. Throughout the month, the numbers shot up from 4.6K to 20K, and I’ve discovered an entirely new level of happiness! 
- Twitter: also witnessed an x4 growth!

The community just went full speed at Shred & Tear for real. Lucid Realm’s server was flooded with reviews, mostly very thoughtful and well-put from both the player & indie dev perspectives. I couldn’t be more grateful. 

Let’s read it the review again cause I want to relive the moment hehee

“Overall, even so early on, the graphics are very polished and I hope to see more as time goes on for sure!” - TheoneMantis
“Very cool designs. Kajun's design is absolutely amazing!” - Justenrules 
“Excellent choice of music, sound effects, especially for enemy attacks and Kajun's reactions could be a bit louder” - MetalCaveman
“The small enemies feel way too fast and aggressive. They more or less instantly hit you if you get close, forcing you into a hit and run playstyle.” - Horsen
“The tunnel; the comic art; the interesting story and concept; Kajun's two-tone hair and her large breasts.” - Patriot-Warrior 
“Rip and tear your way through tentacle monsters wanting to destroy humanity.” - Titanium 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/289167d3b7a4e02f368e54a280a4a76359a369e1.jpg[/img]

[h2]July 2022 - Appearance revamp[/h2]

Our prototype clearly deserved a much more polished presentation. While we were at it, I’ve also touched up the website and uploaded a new teaser trailer as well. 

[previewyoutube=Od8O0Jx1AS4;full][/previewyoutube]

Meanwhile, the hype from June was still lively. The team and I received around 200 feedback and reviews in the span of 2 months. That was crazy, but somewhat scary too. Not of the critical comments, but the anxiety of how I would return the favor of such a supportive community with so much expectation for S&T and me. Criticisms were sent in essays, no jokes guys.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/e7d0fc57e9c1fd39ecacb5ffaef44a526c0337ae.png[/img]
[h3]Never-released-before fact #9: 95% of our players fell for the tunnel racing parts. They all being “loved” by it to death, like literally hundreds of death counts. And the amount of feedback - Oh boy *smh* [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/5a95968ad57b617f7a3e5526476bf4375a117565.png[/img]

[previewyoutube=_7zVbur4gnA;full][/previewyoutube]

and now?

[previewyoutube=r-9i2lc8Kg4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Phase 3: What’s next? [/h1]

[h2]August 2022 - Great challenges come with great bosses[/h2]

A protagonist will need their rival to shine. I get that. Creating a worthwhile boss for Kajun-chan to fight against was always top priority. You guys must have seen it since August.

[h3]Never-released-before fact #10: This was the first mood board for the big boss.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/297b34bfc8ad70d02c5aa40e0e972abb6d6aed63.png[/img]
While we are at it , here are some early sketches for the Tentamon creeps: 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/5f453d16852a396c594e56a88f3a0d311a8cc0db.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/ddff1629e9e6b08fa56b013c06510c578972739f.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/7c8580edb7a92a72260c3a4532968ba08c0bcae1.jpg[/img]
Final & animation

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/3f8ece4e18c294d5b5adcae22e2a2fb5305b4a8a.gif[/img]

They gonna "massage" Kajun-chan to her end yeah ? 

[h2]September 2022 - Tear it down, build it up again [/h2]

Not the whole demo, of course, but there were some critical parts that needed to be revamped, and others rebuilt from scratch. The gameplay, and the flow of the demo, were smoothened out with more features that make sense while playing, especially the racing tunnel. 

Let’s have a look at the new and improved tunnel sequence. 

[previewyoutube=Y2ooQcXYofc;full](revamp tunnel vids)
[/previewyoutube]

Other than that, we also had some visuals spiced up, like Kajun’s private time.

[previewyoutube=F2cJhlEkAuM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]October 2022 - New! Shiny! Steamy! Hot features[/h2]

Another prototype in 2023 ? In such a short amount of time, I should really be worried about bringing new dishes to the menu. And I’ve really exceeded my limit. I’ll list my top 5 new favorite features you can experience in the next demo 
[olist]
[*] Lucid Studio: replacing Photo Mode with A LOT of modification to do
[*] Teleport system: Who knows where this will take Kajun?
[*] New Kajun’s attacks: Throw, heat, pop? Those tentamons will have a hard time. 
[*] Targeting system: More tentamons mean you have to keep more than an eye on the battle.
[*] Bullet hit system: Lock it, hit it, with speed of course. 
[/olist]

[h2]November 2022 - A month of VFX[/h2]

Aside from gameplay, I know my guys ! They are all about the visual buffet. And I delivered. From the gory side of the game which is bloody and messy, to the sexy side we all know, every element can get a little more magical with effects. And VFX did add to Kajun-chan’s badass level! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/ea035f453c6f00ea78bdf373f0fc15d40b1f9be8.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/0542a91e72799ff38e6a36b369b6ddcff0d2ca2f.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/85415b5bcb3857ad837a8c331e998b88fb603043.gif[/img]

[h2]December 2022 - Our hidden event[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/e7d0fc57e9c1fd39ecacb5ffaef44a526c0337ae.png[/img]
[h3]Never-released-before fact #11: It’s what you’ve known for some months now.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/16769666ad1b1dab2180d44866aef107ea825564.png[/img]
As our anniversary approaches, we came bearing gifts, as well as news of promotions for something that is in the making ~ 
2023 will be the official launch of our Patreon Channel! 
→ Join our Discord to learn more. I shouldn’t say more. What happens on Discord, stays on Discord! 

[h1]A tribute to our folks[/h1]

A community with like-minded people - never in a million years could I ever imagine I’d get such a chance! I’ll let you in on some of the remarkable milestones here. 

[h2]Wishlists, followers & other supporters[/h2]
I can’t thank you, (yes you) enough. Since you are also a part of this story, our story. I didn’t know when you joined the force, but I hope you’ll be with us for a long time to come! 

Here are some of our biggest moments: 
[h2]First 500 total added wishlists & 1K followers - Jan 3, 2022 - one month after Steam ‘debut’

10K total added wishlists & 4.6K followers - June 6, 2022 - before the Steam Next Fest storm

Peak of the year - Daily added wishlist balance +1671 - Jun 13, 2022 - the storm

20K total added wishlists - July 11, 2022.

30K total added wishlists - November 28, 2022[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/e7d0fc57e9c1fd39ecacb5ffaef44a526c0337ae.png[/img]
[h3]Never-released-before fact #12: Our reach/likes/view has always been organic. Zero marketing budget. 
[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/cae5c955a2dc01adeb8ea4cdaf91c552611a5097.png[/img]
[h1]Who has joined me in this journey?[/h1]

I was on my own (for too long I can't remember) with this vision until these folks came along! 

Lily - my assistant, marketing-researcher-cum-community-manager - you'll be speaking to her probably more than me sometimes.

[url=https://twitter.com/koenjiaddams]Koenji [/url]- our Jr UE4 Dev - he is in charge of mostly building the AI system, how intelligent the Tentamon is!

[url=https://www.lucastuttle.com/]Lucas Tuttle [/url]- the man behind the badass soundtracks of Shred & Tear!

[url=https://twitter.com/_PixieWillow]✦𝙿𝚒𝚡𝚒𝚎𝚆𝚒𝚕𝚕𝚘𝚠✦[/url] - she literally brought Kajun-chan to life with her playful dynamic VA job~

[url=https://twitter.com/hiragana_01]Hiragana [/url]- a great mecha artist that works with refining and lining a lot of our comic parts. His vision just simply goes align with me. 

Thank you all, I'm glad to have you guys as my companions in this tough marathon. Let's have a feast next year, and beyond ~


And well, I suppose that’s a wrap! I hope I’ll see you next year. 
________________________

From PDD - Dark Lord of Lewd

Kajun: PDD will you remind them this is not an H game?? Come on, you said it is 16+

Kajun-chan above all, is still a young woman with a lot to learn and discover. Fighting is not all there is to her. Being human, Kajun is stubborn and tenacious, and not so easily “tamed” into becoming a mindless, unfeeling weapon. So she’s aggressive, from the beginning, in and out. Be careful!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/22ff54bd00b67ec40df023acc6d22dbbe1a63971.jpg[/img]

[h2]How to draw Kajun[/h2]

You saw that last omake right? I thought everyone should have been able to draw Kajun, so I made this quick tutorial. Trust me, it’s not that hard, really! #amongus #Kajunamongus

[h2]Heavy punisher drone[/h2]
[previewyoutube=OlbHMfHHZXk;full][/previewyoutube]

These enemies will be no stranger to those of you who have played our first prototype. But for those new to the feast, they are called Heavy Punishers, and they are a force to be reckoned with. If you underestimate them, they will be sure to rack up your death counts. But this time around, they will evolve into something new - an even more deadly threat to Kajun’s journey. You will have to deal with the eye-leveled troop of Tentamons, AND, look out for aerial attacks by these drones. As if the battle is not intense enough? Yeah, the bosses are also much more vicious. Nothing too extra ~ buy another set of eyes if needed xD

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/85415b5bcb3857ad837a8c331e998b88fb603043.gif[/img]

The gory aspects of S&T will continue to improve as the game grows. I might call these VFX as Bloody (and dumb) ways to die Collection. The Tentamons will not rest in peace, they will rest in pieces. Sliced, diced, minced into fine paste. They will die vertically, horizontally, in two pieces, or many pieces. It is up to you to be the crafty chef and guide Kajun’s hand in eviscerating them.

[h2]Armor Reveal Effect[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/d5018bb4d26e81c607b0772af9258f29efc791c7.gif[/img]

This is a Sailor Moon tribute. Or I might call Kajun an isekai-Usagi-with-an-attitude-and-mecha-amor. That’s a cool alternative name if I’m being honest!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/5a146a2310d577b572166046a289b800980b3cd9.gif[/img]

As I have mentioned early on when S&T was in the beginning phase of development, there will be interactive scenes. However, implementing them can be a pain sometimes. There’s a laundry list of ideas that I’ve crossed out. Should I make them H-level? 16+? I can’t make up my mind (yet), so I’ll just play with them b-bouncy first. Imma enjoy my privilege ~

Kajun: [i]PDD, you either have nothing to do, or being too annoying right now ughhhhh Stop Gnocchi right there! [/i]

Camera angle is everything in a hardcore hack-and-slash. So for a more comfortable experience during the game, I’ve made some major changes to the third-person camera. This will allow you guys to both better admire Kajun-chan and stay focused in battle. Oh, and Kajun’s armor can show up with more elements that support her during attack, as the skill level goes up! So you’d better be practicing, real hard. 

[h2]Out of space tentacle action[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/cc4cfae608007e15a2e23cb9a1c098c9446e2320.jpg[/img]

Kajun-chan is out of this world, physically and well, also in our eyes. Battles will be brought outside of the basecamp as well, but I'll wait for the right time to let you guys see more of these. Gotta polish both the environment and the epicness of the whole scenes hehe. Maybe I should work on it as a small cinematic project? Is it a good idea guys? 

[h2]Emoticons[/h2]

50 shades of Kajun. But imma guess these are all spicy. Spicy smile, spicy blush, spicy angry (or hangry?), spicy shock? I just know she’ll add spice to any of her expressions here. Let’s do some quick translation:

notes.title: It's saucy time - Dev blog #10
notes.notes:
[h1][b]It’s saucy time #10
＼＼\\٩( 'ω' )و //／／
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/f364b91c28613978667fb7c78c1df56f4226f161.png[/img]

Greetings, men of culture (and ladies)![/b][/h1]

It has been a restless month for all of us here at Lucid Realm. The past weeks have been a very reflective and constructive time after the first prototype, we have received plenty of criticism, love and maybe some tiny hate, but they’re much appreciated. Our production is well on track, and the planning for Patreon has been getting much smoother. I want to make sure you guys get the reward you deserve (*´∇｀*)

I suppose I shouldn't keep it in the oven for too long. Serving time ε=ε=ε=ε=ε=ε=┌(´▽｀)┘

[h1][b]Highlight Events[/b][/h1]
[h2]Patreon preparation[/h2]

Patreon turned out to be considerably more complicated when it comes to pledgers’ awards. And with that bear in mind, I really want to get into details of how you can be rewarded. 

Have you guys printed out any Shred & Tear items? Check out this DYI Skateboard S&T designed by the super talented @titanricky08. I would be very excited to know if you’ve got any ~~ I’m working on ideas for merch for you guys too. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/575c4bea3bc086b44fc36021752acd25fe534e28.png[/img]

These are our tentative ideas for the time being, please cast your votes and I’ll see what fine treat I can fix up for you!

A. Kajun-simp-T-shirt for a fierce outfit 
B. Kajun-mug for your hot morning coffee
C. Kajun-poster for the wall over your bed xD
D. Kajun-4K-wallpaper (because why not?) ~

[b][h1]Community activities[/h1][/b]

Check out one of Kajun-chan’s … b-best shot ( ͡° ͜ʖ ͡° ) from our member @Jim Jim on Discord
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/d68ca7c683c2c2350204ce09944b5cc68198f07c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/bb0f25864a22e54088fe6f78f9095be618bdc97a.png[/img]

[b][h1]Current State of Shred & Tear[/h1][/b]
[h2]Kajun-chan’s close-up shot [/h2]

When I was working on the first concept of Kajun-chan (or I might say with any character concept), I focused mostly on her personality, and how her appearance can show her true self. 

For Kajun-chan, her aggressive-looking metal armor is not the only indication of just how hot-tempered she is. Before being captured by Tentamon, Kajun-chan was already naturally fearless, straightforward, and short-fused. Her facial expressions, therefore, should be sharp and piercing to convey this idea. Striking a fine balance between fierce and cute was one of the initial hurdles for the team, but we managed to come up with a design that’s both powerful and sexy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/bdd411e46a6f91a7a01e18119b7c07d798c30dbe.jpg[/img]

Don’t you lie to these eyes, she knows. (*´ー｀*)

[h2]New comic![/h2]

We’ve got a short comic series coming soon that serves as a prequel of sorts to Kajun-chan’s raging era. She was once a normal girl living her best life, until those freaks came! Looking at that young, naive Kajun-chan. She is much calmer now, knowing that anger will ruin the bigger picture. But don’t you say that to her during her battle. She’ll shred you instead…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/219fc62bee86425543a7c6374441b86ad77ab49d.png[/img]

Kajun-chan: You’d better warn people, PDD. YOU have to handle the consequences, don’t you? 

[h2]Hardcore racing tunnel[/h2]

“Harder? Isn’t it already hard enough as it is?” 

Yes, you read that right. The tunnel race is about to get even harder. Since I am a fan of fast-paced action and high doses of dopamine, it is often vital that a level be made hard enough to satisfy the adrenaline rush, and there’s no better fit for this than the tunnel race segment. Granted, it can be a bit overwhelming, and I know you might leave this part of the game with somewhat 100+ death counts, but you have my word: It’ll feel awesome!

[previewyoutube=r-9i2lc8Kg4;full][/previewyoutube]

You have to keep your head on a swivel looking out and avoiding obstacles while dashing at blazing speeds. This will be incredibly intense, like a searing flambé. 

[h2]Teleport feature[/h2]

Testing time is here. Since the previous prototype, I’ve cooked up a big batch of new ideas to test out. All of them will cover the life of Kajun-chan before she can escape from these creeps. Not only the battles but also personal alone time for our girl.

And about this Teleport one, it will most likely shift you to an unexpected part of the base camp when you are caught off guard, or you may just teleport to a tutorial area where you can train Kajun-chan skills in peace!. So be prepared, you’ll never know where this will take you on the Lucid journey ;) 

What do you think of this feature? Will you be able to handle it? 

[previewyoutube=vgJu6V6gfoY;full][/previewyoutube]

Kajun-chan: Stop asking them about non-sense PDD. ME MYSELF & I can handle it. ಠ_ಠ

[h2]Combo pop-up display[/h2]

Another day, another battle. I tried out the combo display for you so the player would have some kind of reward for mass killing!. This not only gives a sense of how resilient enemies are but also shows Kajun-chan’s skills & speed during battle. However, this is only in my draft. Is there any way I can improve on this one? Some suggestions on Twitter for the kill count naming, which sound really thrilling! ( example ) 

Any other suggestions? Let me know in the comment, eh?

[previewyoutube=PNrLhp0_Q54;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Kajun-chan’s skills level up[/h2]

As time goes on, Kajun-chan will develop more skills, leading to better performance during battles, but guess what? It will also allow you to customize her appearance to your heart’s content ( ͡° ͜ʖ ͡°)

[previewyoutube=2X5Y2CtFgOk;full][/previewyoutube]

Our men of culture will surely be excited about this. I bet it with all the lewd in this world. 
The customization range definitely can be much wider than you thought. That really depends on your imagination alone ;)


[h2]Lucid Studio mode[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/652a1801e5f1c1f95fcc2a45d8c0b70701ed6a99.gif[/img]

I save the best for last. Cause this is what you have all been asking about since day 1. The fan-service. Lucid Studio mode is built on this core value, and I am overly excited to bring to our beloved players a whole new level of ‘satisfaction’.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/b11e7cf7715dd74034c6380729c1a86fb76cb0bf.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/45e2305fa775e90e08682a33b872e9a2a3aabc80.gif[/img]

There will be animations. There will be poses. Some might even be explicit ones (should I release them as an exclusive package dedicated to Patrons that support us?). Let me know if you’d want that as a reward! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/58b599577c1763f859f4a8c63f4cb93b67860aac.gif[/img]

Kajun-chan: *amazed & angry at the same time* PDD, you say what poses? 

[b][h1]________________________

From PDD - Dark Lord of Lewd[/h1][/b]

notes.title: It's saucy time - Dev Blog #9
notes.notes:
[b][h1]It’s saucy time #9
＼＼\\٩( 'ω' )و //／／

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/d28b0aeff67f3f3d3fa52eafca25d585357453f2.png[/img]

Greetings, men of culture (and ladies)![/h1][/b]

Oh heck… Σ（ﾟдﾟlll） has it been a month already? It’s our 9th time doing this, and I feel grateful. Since it has been one hell of a journey, I would like nothing more than to demonstrate my gratitude for your support! We are now much closer to the first anniversary of Lucid Realm, Shred & Tear, and Kajun-chan’s “debut”. As I have teased in the last update, we will have another prototype released by the end of this year to show our progress, as well as get more feedback. So please look forward to the upcoming part of Shred & Tear: Explosive Kajun! 

Okay, let’s dive into this sauce!

[h1][b]Highlight Events[/b][/h1]
[b][h2]Patreon Suggestion[/h2][/b]

I have been diligent at studying the ways of my fellow Patreon creators, and truth be told the content structure is giving me some difficulty coming up with ideas. The reward packages I’ve been thinking of are based on donation tiers. They will not be a one-time thing but will gradually build up and thicken over time. 

I think it worth mentioning again that I take Patreon and donations as the source of wholesomeness. It’s not for the main purpose of attracting a sponsor for this project. This small budget should be more like personal fuel for me to whip up some more art and visual stuff for close folks to munch on. 

Here are some of the pieces that I have been fixing up in the kitchen for the past months. It's a mixture of both my personal work during my freetime and content I cooked up for Shred & Tear. Will you guys welcome this type of content on Patreon too?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/daa61300331e5d990ff222d4ec898f3b2dfc0a9c.png[/img]

It could be PSD file of my original work with NSFW content/layers, and even it's ZTL 3D printable file from my own 3D models as well if my Patreon doing really well!

[b][h1]Community & Press activities[/h1][/b]
[b][h2]Fanart Compilation[/h2][/b]

Our Realmers are artists...or rather, “artists”, if you catch my drift. They do have some really keen artistic senses though. Have a look at some of the fancy artwork they have shared with us on the channel.

Have you finished the Demo? If you haven’t, either join our Discord, or get it done, to see this version of Kajun-chan (heehee!). Tribute to lolicon09, they truly have captured a pair of jiggling… screenshots!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/aa1da5fd986245356c65fc5f1cbc55635526f906.png[/img]

Ah… and this one from Demon of Chaos. They’ve gone above and beyond to recreate Kajun-chan in the world of Phantasy Star Online 2. She’s still our mecha waifu, but sure has some edges over there with the metal fists right? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/8e0e5c1587816e6b94902d5646d1d3f8295b7ac6.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Current State of Shred & Tear[/b][/h1]
[h2][b]Get ready for the tunnel raid… remake![/b][/h2]
You heard that right! The tunnel raid is being completely overhauled right now and will be available in the next update. It’s unfortunately a point of frustration for many of you guys for a number of reasons, from the design choice to the wonky stage design and associated gameplay shift that resulted in many cheap deaths. 

[previewyoutube=Y2ooQcXYofc;full][/previewyoutube]

And yes, we have taken in all of your feedback and comments, it’s about time to hit resolve on the tunnel. It was once our most hyped concept to ever be released (like almost 10k+ upvotes on Reddit), and admittedly it was a bit sad for us that people didn’t quite enjoy it like we thought they would. We’re gonna make things (hopefully, fingers crossed!) better this time! 

[h2][b]New boss reveals itself[/b][/h2]

[previewyoutube=INnqbhjKA2E;full][/previewyoutube]

You know this one right? It was first introduced back in January and is now ready for the battle with Kajun-chan. It’s called Squalomon, a much more aggressive brother to Salumon MK II. This boss can be quite a trouble to Kajun-chan since it has one monstrous pair of jaws. And unlike Salumon, this one is dangerously fast on its feet, to chop our girls to pieces. 

[previewyoutube=n5gYB6iUjDM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2][b]Kajun-chan's new attack move[/b][/h2]

As you might have noticed, at the end of the previous part, you can see quite a few attack moves that Kajun-chan cannot perform (yet). These are meant to be implemented in the next prototype. Kajun-chan will not only shred, but also squeeze the heck out of these vile Tentamon. She’ll be boiling these enemies and popping them like corn! With a healthy dollop of butter on top, of course!

Before the throw - A tentamon being boiled by the heat waves from Kajun-chan's claws:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/ea035f453c6f00ea78bdf373f0fc15d40b1f9be8.gif[/img]

In battle:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/e7b4b10b0cad576dd819e44eb5db56f999313551.gif[/img]

[b][h2]Bullet Hit indicator[/h2][/b]

Tentamons are coming from way too many directions? You cannot see who, or what is coming your way? Kajun-chan is so pissed her death count is like 690 times in the game? We hear you! A new feature in the upcoming release is the directional damage indicator, which will alert you of where enemy projectiles will be coming from. Never be caught with your pants down again!

[previewyoutube=crpASGmsni0;full][/previewyoutube]

[b][h2]Kajun-chan’s maintenance room[/h2][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/aaae793b6fdefbeadd9c2c6aa39f2280ca50759f.gif[/img]

Are you curious about what Kajun-chan would look like when she took off her armor and finally was able to catch her breath? She would appreciate these armor-less moments I bet. A small question, what should Kajun do at the end of her day, in this room to recover from the heat? Let me know in the comment section, since you know, I might actually… ( ͡° ͜ʖ ͡°)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/dfcb3954ad09cd024bcacf13f493d625c786ceac.gif[/img]

From PDD - Dark Lord of Lewd[/b][/h1]
