notes.title: It's saucy time - Dev blog #8
notes.notes:
[h1][b]It’s saucy time #8
＼＼\\٩( 'ω' )و //／／
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/1c60ab8af205590503495a37d1057bda5c5ec262.png[/img]
Greetings, men of culture (and ladies)![/b][/h1]

PDD is here to greet you! It’s that time of the month again. I believe we have reached a critical milestone, where we must not only refine the current gameplay demo, but also plan for the future. What is the pivotal step for Lucid Realm on this development path? As the game’s popularity grows, I’ve been feeling both proud and anxious. 

For the time being, I've been working on our strategy for the future year with our team! Let's get started with this month's report! 

[h1]Highlight Events[/h1]
[h2]Upcoming Phase of Shred & Tear - Announcement![/h2]
After the Demo was released at Steam Next Fest, we’ve been given the opportunity to witness your love and support and, most of all - valuable feedback from players. This was our first significant achievement for the game. Even though it might be insignificant compared to the industry’s giants, for such a small team, we consider this as a major stepping stone for our upcoming future. It set the bar high for our upcoming works, yet we acknowledge that the hardship is yet to come! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/3e4f2ddabb54a79fde99f9eb565c8b8500a95fe0.jpg[/img]
We want to make it official here - the next phase of the gameplay Demo will be released around end of 2022 or early 2023! With the wealth of earned experience in making games, my team and I will make sure it is elevated, a big shift in storytelling and worldbuilding! You guys can expect to see more of Kajun-chan, and much fewer bugs (fingers crossed!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/b60ce94f4284e0e384f4ac7d68117a54944ad97e.png[/img]
This next announcement may be a bit difficult to explain, but we will be giving Patreon a shot for the coming future as well. This was not a decision that I’ve made lightly, but I feel the call to come back to game art sooner or later. The game is going well at this rate, but it will be much better if I do what I do best. Overall, it is a universe of sexy beasts that I’m building - the world of Lucid! With that said, more details should be available on the Patreon, and I also have some questions:


How much is “too much”? And how much is “considerable” (for the donation tiers)?
Rewards? - I have loads on my mind. For example, sketches, early previews, 2D/3D artpacks? Tell me what you would expect to receive down in the comments!

[h1]Community & Press activities[/h1]
[h2]Steam[/h2]
Let’s look at one of the most detailed feedback that we have EVER received! Comment down here if you agree with kazemel89. 

[h3]“I do think Gnocchi should speak a little unusual English or add some alien lexicon as it is an alien to convey or highlight his otherworldliness. Him saying “Aw fiddlesticks” or “holy hot ravioli'' is too human, maybe a made up alien cuss words or swear like “Frell!” or “Zeck!” Not saying you can’t still do it have “holy hot ravioli'', I found it humorous, just a suggestion to make him more alien.”[/h3]
→ An alien language? That’s a pretty cool idea actually, we’ve got some ideas that we would like to expand upon as the development progresses. How would Gnocchi sound? I really wonder. Is there a voice I can take for reference? 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/b8ec81159b74a6849b7338109a93b85bfc137ed2.png[/img]

[h3]“Curious what is Kajun’s character and personality like. Looks can only drive a character and narrative so far. Hope we find out more about her and what she was like before being transformed or what her new powers is transforming her personality into.”[/h3]
→ Trust me mate, I have plans to reveal her past ;) In a comic format again eh?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/eaff51ed1900d2919f6b800d4c9c661db041cd24.png[/img]

[h3]“So what motivates and drives Kajun-chan and Gnocchi on a personal level? We know her body has transformed, but how will her personality, character, drives, and hopes change through the course of the game/story? Why does Gnocchi want to stop TEABAGS and needs to use Kajun-chan to accomplish it?”[/h3]
→ The TEABAG is not quite a united community I must say. They have different goals and mindsets, just like us humans! Tentamon’s technology is something quite interesting. They look cool, but honestly, not too humane :) the true reason and story of Shred & Tear will be slowly revealed as the game progresses later on! So no spoilers! 


[h2]Discord[/h2]

It has been some time since our last photo mode contest. Would you be interested in another competition? We have been working hard on developing the plot and world lately, and with them, many new bosses and creatures are in the concept phase. This means we’ve got a lot of naming to do! Would you like to join us? 

Do you have any other activity you would want our Community managers to host? Let them know in #general *calling for Lily & Dawnbreaker*


[h2]Fanart[/h2]
[h3]Fanart by Demon of CHAOS[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/bbf623810939590869c26d3c6688b5bf740bc542.jpg[/img]
POV: Kajun-chan signed up to cast for the next protagonist of Transformer. #feminist


[h3]Fanart by Sugar Spikes[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/786659901d74428d7d291bfb16c7487d9d93a79a.jpg[/img]
POV: Kajun-chan is unarmed and stabilized, but her death glare will still pierce into your soul! 

[h1]Current State of Shred & Tear[/h1]
[h2]New MERC boss coming (Sketch & 2D concept)[/h2]

As I have mentioned, this is the critical phase for us to develop a more profound story of Shred & Tear. Not only for this part but maybe even for the upcoming titles. The new (unnamed) boss is here, and to keep things brief, she is a middle-rank officer of the Tentamon army. Therefore you can fully expect her to be a tough customer. Kajun-chan had better trained herself well! Heehee! 

( ͡° ͜ʖ ͡°)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/19c1faf1ff6ef05497fdc427ad4773db59fbf5e9.jpg[/img]
Stage - Sketch

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/e4db617e654f2914a638379563ef7106f0dce01e.png[/img]
Stage - Colored concept

The current development state will be quite short for the time being since fixing bugs and developing strategies have been quite labor-intensive. We’ll present the WIP when it’s more polished, eh? 

[h2]Some more boss developments [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/eac969fda2a2bca1d1688ac05f5216b128116ac7.jpg[/img]

As you might have seen, there’s a giant creature at the very end of the Demo, or I might say biomechanical mutant, coming after Kajun-chan. This gives a great preview of what I plan for the boss designs. “Intimidating” is the keyword, as also “ruthless” and “merciless.” This also means Kajun-chan’s got her work cut out for her since they will not be giving her any room for error. Hope she’ll be ready for the upcoming training session *smh*


[h2]Kajun-chan’s armor - candy to the freaking eye[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/e3eb3e16453650c7f2694bfbb0ca75e9f04d7c8a.png[/img]

Are you impressed with Kajun-chan’s armor? Oh boy, you didn’t know, right? She is guaranteed to be kitted out with much more technology and alternative skins along the way. Sneak a peak right here! Doesn’t she look FIERCE with the design? Don’t even worry about how she’d move; the turbo boosters she has will also be updated! Await Kajun-chan ~

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/41a298bd9edc4ecbea00df4bfba84c9cde1529d1.jpg[/img]

And these are also some ideas for Kajun-chan’s skins. The idea is that Kajun-chan will have to contend with more than just Tentamon, but also gigantic bosses of all kinds. She must look as aggressive and ready as she can be, and her armor must also make sense considering her power bar. Kajun-chan can be quite furious sometimes; she might get a burnout there.  
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/182e8292d1d25d4a999527b0d9a22eaff40a3103.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/66c9b4195c766e27159d2c2840d68af0f18e1238.png[/img]

[h2]2D Comic Artist in need![/h2]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/e0d287de4642e46069a900a6e39531148aba3f27.jpg[/img]
I have some plans in mind for a Shred & Tear short comic and many individual paintings in the near future. Do you happen to know of any talented artists suitable for our project? Or, if you feel like you are a great artist, please take some time to send your profile to Lily (Discord: Lily P.#7102) or just leave a comment below. We’ll be waiting for you guys!

That’s it for today! Let me hear your opinions down below~

[h1]________________________

From PDD - Dark Lord of Lewd[/h1]

notes.title: It's saucy time - Dev blog #7
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/55a3beffb58cfd0e09b9b29342be5003075610a2.png[/img]
[h1]It’s saucy time #7
＼＼\\٩( 'ω' )و //／／[/h1]

[h1]Greetings, men of culture (and ladies)![/h1]
It’s me, PDD, and yet another month has passed. I have heard comments from Steam that this doesn’t “seem” to be a devblog. I am fully aware of that, but guess what, I don’t mean to make it sound like a boring devblog full of technical stuff. I’m the dev, yes, but this is rather a blog for everyone to catch up on and share this journey with me in creating and working on Shred & Tear in all aspects, Kajun-chan and Shred & Tear. Yes, I will update the WIP and tech side, but also other things that I find exciting to share! 

Hope you’ll enjoy this saucy time of the month with me! Let’s jump right in. 

[h1]Highlight Events[/h1]
[h2]Steam Next Fest[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/c43c34033ac3e04131e16d355d51b3724e54896a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/c329bd7146ce68b9df9c36eef15b90b5f6e437f4.jpg[/img]

Welp, Steam Next Fest was really designed for all stripes of indie game developers out there. It was a real and strong motivation for me to complete the early prototype for this festival, and Steam had been very supportive as they encouraged players to try out and share their feedback with developers. By the end of 7 days of Steam Next Fest, we have seen more than 26,000 unique player downloads, one of the biggest milestones for me up to this point. Many of them had taken their precious time to sit down and provide us with very wholesome and constructive feedback. 
I almost have a heart-attack reading through the feedbacks seeing people shred & tear the game apart with their opinions but I think it's good for me to grow as an indie dev. 
Feedback from players is the most valuable thing an indie dev can receive! Not gonna lie about that! 

I’ll keep it short and share with you guys our big achievements this June, with generous help from Steam!

[h2]26,000++[/h2] [h3]unique player downloads[/h3]
[h2]20,000++[/h2] [h3]wishlist adds[/h3]
[h2]1500+[/h2] [h3]total members in the Discord server[/h3]

Here are some thoughts on the game that people shared with us on Discord & Steam.

[h3]“Graphics are amazing, and enjoy the hack and slash of the minions, fast paced."[/h3] - Kazemel89

[h3]“tbh i might just be a horny bastard, but the game looks better then i thought! Music sounds great, Gameplay is kinda fast paced, fun and fast. you can also respawn fast after dying”[/h3] - Manectricz

[h3]“The game is better than I thought, it's just a playable hentai but it can be cool, I would like to see new combos in this time I played it got repetitive” [/h3]- Cuê 

Just a little reminder that this is more or less merely a prototype! Please look forward to our “Alpha Demo version” around the end of this year! 

[h2]Photo Mode Contest Recap[/h2]

Some games are just so good not to take screenshots of during gameplay, and as an avid gamer myself, I understand the frustration of not being able to just “snap” the right moment. Thus, we have decided to implement a Photo Mode and a contest where fellow players can share their spiciest moments!

The scale that I chose for the contest was based on the badass and lewd level that Kajun-chan is. So far, we have received over 100 screenshots from our playtesters, even after the contest has officially ended, and picked 2 of them for the platinum prize! Let’s take a few minutes to admire their masterpieces again! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/48adb6b1ddfbb2cdcfa33e4663384715bd03182f.jpg[/img]
and there are alot more beautiful shots featuring the finest of Kajun-chan's as well , please sure to check out our Discord for more ! 
here are a few more from user Kuroshu !
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/6437def72611f4b680b928b9d60c91dc48379b20.jpg[/img]
[h1]Community & Press activities[/h1]
[h2]Community[/h2]
[h3]Speed-run achievements[/h3]

According to our Steam statistics, the players in our community take around 15-20 minutes to finish the Demo. Meanwhile, there’s a little speed run competition among the troops. The best one out there must be from Horsen!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/4a3f7e1a96d07c651e2a10b5358c7c0a51cd5674.png[/img]

This is what I’ve been working on too - A worldwide Leaderboard! The competition will be fierce, though, so prepare yourself should you decide to brave the charts.

I can see that the skill range of Shred & Tear players are alot wider to those of common games, ranging from fellow cultured men with very few gaming experience picking up the game just for the plots to hardcore gamers want to try out new Hack&slash challenges. So it would be a big challenge for me in the future to do with difficulty ballance and options. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/1544ec9bd9ff7ab4b70f91d032aaa5537fdcd49a.jpg[/img]

[h2]Press[/h2]
During this month, Shred & Tear has caught the attention of so many journalists, YouTubers, and streamers. I have read all of their feedback and felt extra grateful that Shred & Tear has really managed to exceed my expectations and garnered so much support, from literally all over the world. Have a quick peek if you’d like and read through some of the most significant reviews for Kajun-chan!

I cannot thank you guys enough!

[url= https://www.twitch.tv/maliktorihane/video/1313262892][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/3a1324bfe7c8765b54fdf4f0290a65374aa6006f.jpg[/img][/url]
A very excited playthrough  by a fellow tentacle enthusiasmn appreciator Malik Torihane!

[previewyoutube=2VpstknGjpE;full][/previewyoutube]
Planet Bu thought the tunnel raid was way too hard >,<


[previewyoutube=4lHSjb7g7s8;full][/previewyoutube]
Tama Ch from Japan gave huge compliments on our girl’s visual heeehee

and alot more press has covered my little game XD !
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/289167d3b7a4e02f368e54a280a4a76359a369e1.jpg[/img]
[url=https://www.gamespark.jp/article/2022/05/30/118927.html ]Keshino from GameSpark Japan[/url] gave us some critical feedback on game speed and operation sensitivity and his experiences as a whole. 
Another great piece by [url=https://www.alphabetagamer.com/shred-tear-explosive-kajun-beta-demo/]Calum Fraser and Alpha Beta Gamer[/url]. They gave us recognition for both visuals and gameplay!
[url=https://www.playground.ru/shred_and_tear/news/anonsirovana_igra_shred_and_tear_explosive_kajun_nad_kotoroj_rabotaet_dizajner_personazhej_subverse-1170311]2BLaraSex and PlayGround Russia[/url] for taking some time to look into my background!


[h1]Current State of the Shred & Tear[/h1]
[h2]New Trailer[/h2]

[previewyoutube=Od8O0Jx1AS4;full][/previewyoutube]
As always, I have saved the best for last! After the team’s hard work on the Demo, I’ve finally found the time to create a trailer to better depict Shred & Tear’s flaming hot action. What do you guys think about this new version? Let me know in the comment section! 

[h2]New Targeting System[/h2]

[previewyoutube=OpNM7gWp6OU;full][/previewyoutube]
After going through your comments, I have been working really hard on the solution for the battle mechanics in general. This targeting system will help with selecting and quickly locking onto the targeted Tentamons. What do you think/expect of the implementation in the official build of the game? Please let me know. 


[h2]Mini game![/h2]

A lewd game cannot be completed without a little lewd minigame ! This image is not particularly Shred&tear related, just something I am doing in my sparetime but it gave me a good idea the view we should have for a little mini game featuring around Kajun-chan body ! let me know what kind of mini game you are expecting for a lewd & action game ? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/3a081eb447056f2f3140a8b31ad4d1ea17dcea8e.jpg[/img]
That's it for today! I'll see you in the comment section!


[h1]________________________

From PDD - Dark Lord of Lewd[/h1]

notes.title: It's saucy time - Dev blog #6
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/9181e1d2978ce31d840df70836095dd796e26ae2.png[/img]
[h1]It’s saucy time #6
＼＼\\٩( 'ω' )و //／／

Greetings, men of culture (and ladies)![/h1]

It’s June, and the 6th episode of “It’s saucy time” is here. Time flies, it really does. I first established Lucid Realm Studio on November 6, 2021, and merely two quarters later, the Demo of Shred & Tear: Explosive Kajun was officially published on Steam. This may sound really small compared to some of the big sharks out there, but to us, this is concrete proof of our determination. We started with little, and yet we are aiming high and dreaming big! 

If you haven’t tried out the Demo yet, head over to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1826020/Shred__Tear_Explosive_Kajun/]Steam front page[/url] and get a sample of the visual feast we are serving. 

Alright, let’s get started with all of the events that happened 

[h1]Current State of the Shred & Tear [/h1]
[h2]The Demo Release - 20-year journey summed up in 20 minutes[/h2]
[h3]The beginning[/h3]
It takes a lot to get to this point. I have managed to show you approximately 8 months of work on Twitter, but before that point, counting altogether, almost a year has gone by since we started this. However, it didn’t ACTUALLY begin in 2021, in the middle of the pandemic, it was way earlier than that!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/f6525dbe80d1d71598bdd18183abe60c24d5bcc8.jpg[/img]
Some old art when I was 16 and then - now. 
It started with me - a teenage PDD with a burning passion for video games and anime art in the 90s. 

That boy worked his way up to Art School and had been working in the 3D Game/VFX industry since 2005, and strives to world-class level somedays. And I managed to keep that spirit up even to this day (but with a lot more Lewdness injected!!! - since I am an Adult now haha).
Fast forward to 2021 with a whole lotta new challenges, I finally had the resources together, and visualized my Lucid Realm! 

Head over to the Front page or click the banner below  to get a grasp of what that boy had worked on - it will take you roughly 20 minutes ;) and I hope you will enjoy it!
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1826020/Shred__Tear_Explosive_Kajun/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/eaef0ea6584b335f86d7b598fff9e1118bdac88f.gif[/img][/url]

Shred & Tear is just an early entrance to what I have always been dreaming to make over the years! Sexy, Badass, Extra Thick Waifus in actions fighting against the grotesque hideous monsters in brutal hellish worlds!


The changes
As I have mentioned earlier in this episode of It’s saucy time, we have released the first ‘rough’ closed-beta version of the Demo and let our folks in the Lucid Realm server test it out. Sure enough, there were flaws. Then in the rush to refine it, then release it in time for upcoming events, the production team and I had worked our arse off, literally ~ but we managed to clean ourselves up after that so no worries.

What did they spot in the closed beta, and what have we done to refine it? 
We set the survey to cover Graphics, Sound & Music, Gameplay, and Difficulty and received hundreds of comments and roughly 80 critical points to refine Shred & Tear that brought this new version alive! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/95bffb50af6d9c6fe8b718c7e464dfafd97bfda3.jpg[/img]
Look at that long list of todo list I have cleared most of them after the private testing pharse. The Demo now is still needing alot of works but It is enough for you to get a gasp of Kajun-chan full taste !


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/be03430d742a00d36a1550f48c7197fd8d5c6c23.jpg[/img]
First of all, I have quickly put together a photo mode that allows you to take the best shots of Kajun-chan and her glorious battle with Tentamons. Have you tried it out? Post that in the Discord for the troop to admire! I intended this mode for a small “interactive” gameplay session later but it’s good to push it out as an early iteration of the model.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/66dc101d08d7bb290cd3c5d3f9e37bc5ba2e98cc.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/7f1a96faaf56275dab6fd5c8b184b9080de366bf.png[/img]
About Shred & Tear, since the beginning, I didn’t make it tailored to hard-core gamers, I made it for everyone, from men of culture who enjoy lewdness as it is, to people who are fond of gory mecha monsters and fun, violent gameplay. Therefore the feedback on the difficulty of the controller varies widely. I decided to make the Controller setting available. Then further into the game, there will be more skill guides as well as custom key binding for you to work well with Kajun-chan in the battle against those Tentamons! 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/d5162a8d7e75cd41f5e657cd073a99e7c7411860.gif[/img]
As we are targeting a mass group of demographic as well as game experiences, I believe the gameplay will have significant room for improvement. After the playtest, many did encounter multiple bugs related to the combat in general - therefore I really emphasize on this as it is critical to the overall players’ flow. According to some of our testers, the changes were “day and night” comparing version to version. Even though the Tunnel Raid gameplay is still a little buggy at the moment, you have my words, it will get better! 

[previewyoutube=WxepD6qxoIg;full][/previewyoutube]
Last by not least, A Big shout out to (twitter)@_PixieWillow for voicing our lovely Kajun-chan ! perfectly in character and crank the sexy up x69.6 times !


[h1]Highlight Events[/h1]
[h2]Playtesting Private Party [/h2]
As you may have known from the last episode, we have organized a small Playtesting Private Party in our Discord server with over 70 participants. 

Thank you all again for your contribution to Shred & Tear. Your valuable response will be our main motivation to do better. The number didn’t include just our supporters, but also streamers and Youtubers! Please be on the lookout for their reaction videos as well. 

This event honestly put the team in awe of how wholesome, constructive people can be. Just look at how well the original tweet did!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/163d6516a8485654b8f0cc8ade9e4336c8c51d40.jpg[/img]

The tweet alone attracted a flood of newbies to the server. And of course, they had the chance to see Kajun throughout & inside-out first in the prototype demo!

Apart from all the feedback & suggestions I got which are super helpful to know which direction should I polish the game. Some of the feedbacks really give me much motivations to pour my heart & soul to Shred&Tear !

[list]
[*] [h3]“Overall, even so early on, the graphics are very polished and I hope to see more as time goes on for sure!”[/h3] - TheoneMantis
[*] [h3]“Very cool designs. Kajun's design is absolutely amazing!”[/h3] - Justenrules 
[*] [h3]“Excellent choice of music, sound effects, especially for enemy attacks and Kajun's reactions could be a bit louder”[/h3] - MetalCaveman
[*] [h3]“The small enemies feel way too fast and aggressive. They more or less instantly hit you if you get close, forcing you into a hit and run playstyle.”[/h3] - Horsen
[*] [h3]“The tunnel; the comic art; the interesting story and concept; Kajun's two-tone hair and her large breasts.”[/h3] - Patriot-Warrior 
[*] [h3]“Rip and tear your way through tentacle monsters wanting to destroy humanity.”[/h3] - Titanium 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/8b592aa8d359836f4857c87d35f1d06e1816a5d0.jpg[/img]

And of course!  A Big Thank You to everyone who participated in the private play test party and taking time to fill in the Survey ! You guys 's contributions does really help me tremendously in shaping/refining the game toward its better form. I got a little credit slide as a small thanks for all of our 69 testers ! 
In the future, if there is any private play-test for S&T , I hope that we still be able to receive such care & love from you guys. Soon one day we will hop on and meet Kajun-chan again!

[h2]Steam Next Fest announcement[/h2]
Again, about Steam Next Fest, just to keep you guys informed, Shred & Tear is all set for one of the biggest festivals for game developers and promising indie games out there. It is the chance for you to try out our Demo and show your support! I really hope to be able to see you all joining hands during the event and spreading words about Shred & Tear and sharing a little bit of Kajun-chan altogether XD! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/c43c34033ac3e04131e16d355d51b3724e54896a.png[/img]

About Steam Next Fest, it's a big official event by Steam as a multi-day celebration of upcoming games. Explore and play hundreds of game demos, watch developer livestreams, and chat with teams about their games in progress, coming soon to Steam. Even though Shred & Tear final game is far from release but the Prototype Demo is worth trying out !

[h1]Communities & Press activities [/h1]
[h2]The Gamer Section [/h2]
I was so glad to hear from The Gamer Section earlier in May regarding an interview on Shred & Tear and what I had been working on so far. @kayokano was extremely kind and enthusiastic as a host and I got to share many things with the audience of The Gamer Section. You can watch the interview again here, oh and if you like the channel, give him some loves, thumb ups or even subscribe !: 

[previewyoutube=hfi2r-hkbr0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Demo trailer featured by our fellows and friends[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/fe9ff732e21723d30cc55c2c3a568208c9a97f27.png[/img]
From Shady Corner

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/eabe3302bc748394222136c3a453892e11e50e04.png[/img]
From Game Infinite

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/1b142c4024f327b009140f276156852a3c14e6f2.png[/img]
From our beloved Pixie the badass/sexy voice behind Kajun-chan!

[h2]A day in the Server - https://discord.gg/XEqD3nM5wu[/h2]

Just a small reminder: Join us on Discord for the code to unlock our “exclusive” content!

After some time running the server, Ms. Lily - our Community Manager, has finally found herself a companion - the Mod - @Ribbonizer. He is the perfect complementary for her duties, together this duo covers every single timezone there is on this planet Earth! I am so relieved to see people being super welcomed on the server, and literally, no one is left behind! 

Allow me to give you a tour of our server! These are our famous attractions

#snt-faq: Where we answer those frequently asked questions! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/33f44a5f25f6d14a9e9deb2b5fb4c690d52e01ea.jpg[/img]
#snt-discussion: This is where men of culture, ladies, and even Tentamon get to show their passion to Shred & Tear and discuss the experience
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/1328ef2274c2d5557a3b7b2e1c99f8f6e30bf6ea.gif[/img]
#snt-kajun-chan-s-fan-club: Yeah, a place to simp. And you can only simp Kajun-chan, obviously. Wanna see some fanart there? 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/89369bc82ddfccd49fc4c8ccee0bea467055cac0.jpg[/img]

#lewd-land: yeah, there is lewd (Catto) content. Discover for yourself! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/2adc10a9065f93ad7029fcb7d8f3cd03c8a32170.png[/img]

[h2]Snap & Tear: a photo contest[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/9b75f1c8dc383a03cb955aa6b199c96e9b8b7aff.gif[/img]
As the development of Shred & Tear progresses, more features will be added. And we have always wanted to embrace the ‘indie’ element every step of the way. Indie products pride themselves on their power to create very personalized experiences, and that’s what we are aiming for! 

The photo mode is made not only for better interaction within the game, you guys can create your own Kajun-chan masterpiece of Tentamon slaughtering. Isn’t that fascinating? notes.title: It's Saucy Time - Dev Blog #5
notes.notes:
[h1]It’s saucy time #5
＼＼\\٩( 'ω' )و //／／

Greetings, men of culture (and ladies)![/h1]

A month flew by so quickly, faster than any fast food I must say. During April, Shred & Tear: Explosive Kajun was being thoroughly polished and QA’d internally. It has been quite a long journey to reach this very milestone - the first Demo. The closer we are to the date, the more emotional I get. I remembered doing the first brainstorming for Kajun-chan’s concept, to develop the story around it. As time went on, it became not only me who worked on this project, but others also invested their effort to finally get this on the table! 

Let’s cut it short, this will (very likely) be the last Dev Blog before Demo Release! 

[h1]★彡Fresh out of the oven - new & upcoming events!★彡[/h1]
[h2]Playtest Private Party - May 7-8[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/4fffb3130ba8c4a81eae2d3e624fd30b269a90b9.png[/img]

As the Demo is almost finished, we have decided to throw a feast right before the release to our members in Discord. The Playtest Private Party was a closed beta held to get opinions from our supporters and hopefully bring out the best by letting the players’ voices be heard. 

I truly appreciate being an indie developer, despite the many obstacles we’ve faced, because of this small reason - I did wish, once, to be involved in the making of a game. And as Shred & Tear will follow this protocol, at Lucid Realm, we will continue to let people (or Tentamon) build the game with us! 

We had announced the event on May 6, at 10 AM EST, and had hoped to have 50 supporters helping us with polishing the Demo, but our Discord members surprised us with waves of registration! In less than 24 hours, due to popular demand, we had to extend the limit to 70 players! You guys have been extremely enthusiastic at evaluating the game and giving us pointers! I can’t thank you all enough for supporting Kajun-chan and Shred & Tear! 

[h2]Steam Next Fest - Next June 13[/h2]

May began with GREAT news in the Realm’s kitchen! We have signed up to be featured as part of Steam Next Fest! As the plan for Shred & Tear: Explosive Kajun is to be released in 2022, we are totally eligible for the fest. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/c43c34033ac3e04131e16d355d51b3724e54896a.png[/img]

Make note of the date and don’t forget to leave a review for Kajun-chan during the event!

[h1]★彡 Achievements ★彡[/h1]
[h2]Discord explosion! - https://discord.gg/XEqD3nM5wu[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/1328ef2274c2d5557a3b7b2e1c99f8f6e30bf6ea.gif[/img]

You might, or might not have known, that I had announced the server this time last month. And to my utter surprise, in such a short amount of time, we have had over 800 peeps joining our burgeoning community. 

People (or Tentamons) in this Server are a wild, but a very friendly and supportive bunch I must say! You will soon get your hands (or tentacles!) on the Demo when it is made available on Steam. I’ll make it worth the wait! 

[h2]New look on the website - shredntear.com [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/5fe6df52fd3c0fbaa4c7a0b8152f9f4f225c160e.png[/img]

Do check out the website that I have set up for Shred & Tear. We are at our final steps for the public tryout! 

Other parties, press people, Youtuber, or Twitch partners, if you need any further information on the game or Lucid Realm, please hop on to the website and send us a message right away. 

[h1]★彡 Development Progress ★彡[/h1]
[h2]Art & Model[/h2]
[h3]Tentamon troop[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/07141dfae191e53d2600a92173f0ef4cea898cbc.gif[/img]

Yeah by this 5th Dev Blog, I suppose that you all know the Tentamon very well by now, and how they implemented a monstrous and evil plan to take over our dear mother Earth. On Kajun-chan’s way to escape their base camp, she will have to contend with bosses, but also waves of these creatures. They are fast, and of course, furious at anything that goes against them. 

Don’t be fooled by their looks, these come in different sizes, and even compared to Kajun-chan, they are quite intimidating. For real!

[h3]Intro comic strip[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/3d7de84aa60c6d1c0220bcd3eb78959121d60a90.jpg[/img]

From the beginning, Shred & Tear to me has been so much more than just a passion project of what I have been personally fantasizing about for years, but also to show my deepest homage to legends. It was in the 90s that I first encountered video games and since then, I have continuously grown. From making art, to now, making games. Those fresh, overwhelmed feelings keep me going for such a long time. 

And those games often started with a comic intro. Static images and a whole new world opens. I will try to implement more of these factors to Shred & Tear as the development goes on! 

[h3]Concept references[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/d2ef0e104dcd5992160375e52f22413c1d6d6a5d.jpg[/img]

Needless to say, these must be the references for the future. I myself will constantly need more refs for more developments… ( ͡° ͜ʖ ͡°) If you know what I mean!

Kajun-chan: PDD, seriously? 
Me: um… don’t even ask me the obvious… 

[h3]Kajun-chan encounters Salumon[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/c1251fb9e20b66069f9a53e0b73f4871e8b72f58.gif[/img]

One of the bosses that Kajun-chan will have to encounter in the Demo is Salumon MK II. This creature is actually the “living” gate to the complex that will surely deter any attempt at breaking through. If you haven’t had the chance to look at the detailed version of it before, here you go: 

[previewyoutube=I1SvooIPskk;full][/previewyoutube]

That eye has seen so much, but not everyone can get through it. Will you help Kajun-chan?

[h2]Programming[/h2]
[h3]Menu and options[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/5705f55570970e6e276c8099e19d9caa7dae9022.jpg[/img]

I made it extra thick for you guys *appreciation please*. 

You will be able to customize many graphics options to better fit your PC setting. Shred & Tear will be accessible even to potato machines. We will not leave anyone behind. I have posted the minimum PC requirements here for reference! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/bab3052bde9f3db5aca521ce0f7c97ba079361f9.png[/img]

If you have any further questions, don’t hesitate to comment down below, I’ll answer them all! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/15800eda0dbe836a9d081186569d6aa5f5c6f6e6.jpg[/img]

[h3]And if you ever wonder about the Content Unlock, you can get an *exclusive code* by joining our Discord server here: https://discord.gg/XEqD3nM5wu. I will make the announcement there once everything is ready! [/h3]

[h1]________________________

That’s it for today. Go forth, and shred things up, young ones!

From PDD - Dark Lord of Lewd[/h1]

notes.notes:
[h1]It’s saucy time #4
＼＼\\٩( 'ω' )و //／／[/h1]

[h2]Greetings, men of culture (and ladies)![/h2]

It’s PDD, your chef of the night. Even though it’s only been a month since the last dev blog, I still feel like time flies as if it has jet engines under both feet *smh*. Since our previous post, a lot of things have changed, and most of the details are in the refining phase. I myself can feel an exciting and frightening phase approaching. [h2]☆彡Let’s all welcome Shady Corner to the house! [/h2]

Today we will welcome a sous chef in the house - Shady Corner (SC). SC has just the same mindset and vision in games as I do, so we decided to work on publishing Shred&Tear, together, on Steam. Let’s welcome them and visit their [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/shadycorner]Steam page[/url] !! (*´∇｀*)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/7268092291f27258a462a9e77bafb10e224b8cc5.png[/img]

And I didn’t forget about the Demo, it is only days away from being ready to be served up. Y’all can admire the new trailer that SC had done for S&T. Can’t thank the chop chop action from the team enough!!
[previewyoutube=MLJXgtxLuC0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Come, join our Official community channels![/h2]

Yes, I have heard your request! I have been quite overwhelmed with the workload and well, this might be a great time to release these channels as well. Both platforms will run under the brand of Lucid Realm Games where my small team can receive direct messages from you guys. [i]We welcome men of culture (and ladies), or even aliens from the multiverse!  
[/i]

[b]Join and see updates, and find your own troop! ✌︎('ω')✌︎[/b]

Discord: https://discord.gg/XEqD3nM5wu 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/199ff95180296ae3e7ee8be8ac703e430b8ed50d.png[/img]

Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/shredntear/
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/1123bf218d9d54e2d41eba246016a3f49670f328.png[/img]

[i]Please note that I’ll not be there all the time, but our Social Manager will make sure your messages be taken well![/i] (((o(*ﾟ▽ﾟ*)o)))

[h2]Art & Model[/h2]

[h3]Pipes/environment[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/607bb8730bff10101468e916eea03a1b773268b0.jpg[/img]

Kajun-chan is on the next level of detail? Yeah, therefore the other elements MUST match. This explains why great art is often in front of our bare eyes. Working on the environments of Shred & Tear, I want to convey a nostalgic, yet industrial feel when it comes to details. Pipes, a big arena with steaming heat from the Earth’s core, will add to the vibe of Shred & Tear. 

Besides the countless waves of Tentamons, Kajun-chan must be extra careful of the threats right around her!

[h3]Kajun-chan’s emotions[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/19c974a81cc1e3b604230bfbd8407629c453b7ab.jpg[/img]

Take a good guess of what these emotions are and what might cause these expressions on Kajun-chan’s face? 

[i]As an Aries girl, Kajun-chan is the definition of AAA - Ambitious, Adventurous, and Assertive[/i]. And according to L. Corwan (2019) in an article on Saga, “the Aries woman is a fiery creature who likes to be in charge. She’s a lady who knows exactly what she wants in life and will boldly go where others fear to tread, dealing head-on with anything that’s thrown at her.” - isn’t that the most Kajun-chan in a paragraph? Pretty much sum up everything!

[h3]Default 2D Avatar for Kajun-chan[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/5b06100d9c9e30fef4347edb31d13f953bf9fdfb.jpg[/img]

I talked to Kajun-chan the other day to select her 2D Avatar lewks. And she taught me a brand new lesson about the “side”. Yeah? It is how one side looks *significantly* better than the other. I don’t get it? Look at her, and her sideb00bs … any sides look gReAt… /facepalm/

[h3]Avatar with emotions[/h3]
[previewyoutube=c5hV0t5-qgs;full][/previewyoutube] 

Remember when I said I was making Shred & Tear as an homage to some of my biggest inspirations? Remember when I also said this is my passion project? I tried to bring some of those classic features in the game, MY way. 

Taking Kajun-chan’s facial expressions changing during the battle. As a kid, I was stuck in a wow moment when I saw that in the Misadventure of Tron Bonn. Being in an RPG means you get the view from behind and the little avatar will help us connect with the character even more.

[b]Kajun-chan is a real Aries, right? How can she look sexy while being angry? [/b]

[h2]Animation[/h2]

[h3]Level platform/Kajun-chan’s movements[/h3]
[previewyoutube=VPRhfy7avl4;full][/previewyoutube]

As you might have known, Kajun-chan must get her way out of the Tentamon’s underground facility. Those Tentamon and their sonic fast drones will be out from above, from any direction. And while navigating through moving platforms, she has no choice but to be in a highly alert state of mind. 

Kajun-chan’s ability to hop, flee and hush around is not restricted by her armor, but be sure to mix in a combo at a moment’s notice, in case those Tentamons wanted a bite of her!

[h3]Kajun-chan air dash attack[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/20e03477749d0947afad2694601b3477f8e18093.gif[/img]

Kajun-chan is definitely used to being judged by her cover. Her actions will prove otherwise. She can be pretty, but she sure is one hell of a force to be reckoned with! 

Burst attack is extra flashy and eye-candy to many, but Kajun’s air dash is totally on point with its on-time speedy feature. You don’t need to wait or charge up while hitting this attack, it is available on the spot whenever you want it. This allows Kajun-chan to wreck a few Tentamons coming at her during the battle. 

[h3]Death effect & animation[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/b52f003d64a3581c28cba8231e982468fbfeacff.gif[/img]

I have told many at the beginning of Shred & Tear that the game is my absolute homage to DOOM Eternal & Nier:Automata. The Nier part, yes, but… Some people really doubt me when I listed “gory” along with “lusty” as part of the genre tags. 

How gory is that going to be? That can be well established by some aggressive models I have shown before, but let’s take a closer look. In all of Kajun’s glory, those Tentamons will be split in half. Their blood will be shed. And of course, the insides will be right outside *evil smile*

[h3]Bouncing physics[/h3]
[previewyoutube=FwjpvDxiZdA;full][/previewyoutube]

The jiggling will definitely be there, as you may have known. Of course, it will be obvious, but only as of the cherry on top. Along with the live bouncing session. If you have any suggestions, please comment down below! 

However, a friendly reminder, we all MUST focus mainly on Kajun-chan’s badass armor and her journey to slay all those Tentamon. Y’all know she is much more than that.

[h2]Programming[/h2]

[h3]Dialog refine[/h3]
[previewyoutube=CadkvRsFS6g;full][/previewyoutube]

Let me remind you of something. Kajun-chan’s armor is NOT just another piece of metal. It’s biotechnology that allows her assistant to investigate, and give direction. No doubt she’ll feel lost after being held in that hideous chamber for such a long time. If she is going to serve up a delectable main course, having a capable sous chef is a must! 

By choosing 2D cutscenes and illustrated characters, I intended to imply the nostalgia of the last century. The era of comic strips and [i]static[/i] images that [i]move[/i] millions of hearts!

[h3]Just a Meme[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/bacf567bd52ca28d7431703a2ac10062ac3e4f7e.png[/img]

The struggle of every dev, every day, every darn part of the game. If you are reading this and you are also developing your game, then I might have some advice. Don’t listen to your brain, especially after 2 AM… Nobody can guarantee the safety of both you and your game…

[h3]Tunnel Raid gameplay[/h3]
[previewyoutube=V1qdgnAZBV0;full][/previewyoutube]
 
Rushing sonic fast in the tunnel, gazing far far ahead, isn’t it great? Such a view! I wonder what would Kajun-chan be thinking fleeing through this. Will she have time to have a flashback moment to the very old Earth - that used to be her home? 

[h3][i][b]I guess not, Kajun-chan will only move forward. [/b][/i][/h3]

[h1]________________________

That’s it for today. Go forth, and shred things up, young ones!

From PDD - Dark Lord of Lewd[/h1]

notes.title: It's saucy time! - Dev Blog #3
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/b9a89cc049a86af3f5a256e9c77b2f9d7b0b6048.jpg[/img]

[h1]It’s saucy time #3
＼＼\\٩( 'ω' )و //／／[/h1]

[h2]Greetings, men of culture (and ladies)! [/h2]

It’s that time of the month again and I’m back with the saucy updates. As you may have known from the several posts that I made, the Demo for Shred & Tear is coming real soon, hopefully within this month, or early April at the latest. I’m jammed with polishing and setting up the preparation of the final ingredients for this milestone. I really cannot believe it has been over a year of me working on Kajun-chan and these Tentamon freaks!! Let’s see what I’ve gotten for the main course:

[previewyoutube=WaEmGw7JjtE;full][/previewyoutube]

And well, while I’m here working my arse off, Kajun-chan will be out on Tinder looking for her next one to shred *facepalm*

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/39b330e5183b82ccea1dd9c37d0ae88e58a6d7ff.jpg[/img]

I’ll be ready for any questions you might have in the comment section, so hit me up ;) 

Now, fasten your seatbelt, let’s get it shredded up in here! 

[h2]Art & Model[/h2]

[h3]Armored heavy gate[/h3]
[previewyoutube=y8dKU6RRx4U;full][/previewyoutube]

At this point, y’all must have known about Kajun-chan and her main mission to escape the research facility of the Tentamon. But other than those bio-mutant bosses, Kajun-chan is also going to be facing obstacles like this armored gate. It is heavy, closing down at light speed with no warning, and welp, no mercy! 

Yes, these gates are going to make the journey even spicier for her, and they are all over the place. Kajun-chan can go through them, but she can appreciate a helping hand from you. 

[h3]Heavy builder drone[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/4ac0f37e6be4a9a6567b37972dee41fb21acaa1f.gif[/img]

As I have mentioned before (maybe too many times), the Tentamon is a [i]hideous and diabolical species,[/i] but they’re also centuries more advanced than us technology-wise. Whole fleets of these lowly construction drones are the building blocks of their industry and invasion of Earth.

These builder drones do not only serve to build their gigantic headquarters, they can also switch to fight mode with no hassle. Those claws might not be as sharp, but they are still a force to be reckoned with!

[h3]Start menu[/h3]
[previewyoutube=5FY2L3lz9h8;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]The one who knows, knows. The one who doesn’t, doesn’t [/i]( ͡° ͜ʖ ͡°). What do you think of this start menu? The BGM chosen for this screen is meant to hype you up and set a mood for the intense, gory, and of course sexy nature of the game. I got a lot of help from a music producer on this one and will credit him in the game for this contribution! 

Other than that, should I cover “them” up? A good old anime smoky steam or strategically-placed lens flare? Let me know in the comments section below ;)

[h3]A sneak-peak of cutscene sequence (on a Friday night)[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/388aed3f579c7b343af76bbd6d226292bb16ee56.png[/img]

This was me, talking to myself, last Friday, drunk. 

- I’m only one drink away from um… getting no focus, at all… 
- Am I seeing 3 Kajuns? Let’s move around a little.
- She is staring at me, right? Those fierce eyes can be scary at times…
- … gotta adjust the focus, where are her claws tho? 

I heard Kajun-chan clenching her machine claws, and passed out…

[h3]Intro comic[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/0b8cc776f65cf60f7ca41f4064229ed016988a75.jpg[/img]

I am a retro gamer myself and I’ve always seen the charm of the good old traditional comic strip cut scene back in 90s games. The breakthrough in making 3D environment cutscenes is outstanding, yes. But seeing Kajun-chan in 2D is honestly still my favorite thing to do. 

The intro of Shred &Tear will consist of a short comic, telling the story of the Tentamon and how we got to where we are at the beginning of the game. Kajun-chan and her great journey will start there. But of course, there will be a mixture of 3D cutscenes as well to show the badass moment of Kajun-chan in action! 

[h3]More inspiration, pre-Kajun phase[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/5334cb0fd5b5fc2073b090f1ecda0dbb86cde89c.jpg[/img]

Honestly, I’d [i]never[/i] thought my plan would get this far! From a boy who loves playing video games and watching anime to an artist who draws and designs waifu, and now I get to make my own mecha waifu game! Kajun-chan is sexy, yes, and she is so much more than that. She has the capability to shred & tear, and to save this world. [i]But first, let’s all enjoy this view :D[/i]

[h2]Original soundtrack[/h2]

[h3]First soundtrack[/h3]
[previewyoutube=Tuw-qaeJlHo;full][/previewyoutube]

I’ve put huge efforts into polishing the visual, the code, everything, but without the soundtrack, the vibe might not have passed the check. I tried to pay my homage to some legends in this gaming field through Shred & Tear, and choosing metal as the main genre is no doubt! I love how this turned out for the intense battle BGM. 

Just imagine this music playing while Kajun-chan is shredding up the Tentamon [i]*chef’s kiss*[/i]

[h3]Tentamon band[/h3]
[previewyoutube=nW_E9Ntf-uE;full][/previewyoutube]

And behold, another track to set the mood. In a scenario that Kajun-chan is just ‘casually’ stirring up her enemy, this score is on. Not too intense, but certainly feel like ‘shredding music’.

[b]What do you think about these two tracks?  [/b]

[h2]Animation[/h2]

[h3]Tentamon weapon[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/3f8ece4e18c294d5b5adcae22e2a2fb5305b4a8a.gif[/img]

For those Tentamons who don’t get a drone, they’re instead equipped with a handy weapon. Don’t underestimate the size of it, Kajun-chan may be taken down by just a few hits. Not to mention these little freaks are almost everywhere. Frankly saying, they are pretty mad! Kajun-chan is their best experiment yet, and she is turning her back on them. They’ll take her down for good… 

[h3]Heavy builder drone attack[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/1a384d38d0da1f71c608684dc5d5e85aef47fef9.gif[/img]

The builder drone as mentioned above is more than just a construction assistant. They are in the force, ready to battle at any moment. The high voltage electrical hit has an enormous impact on Kajun-chan and her machine’s function. She must get more serious in training her moves and combo, I bet! 

*Texting her to get back and start the session*

[h1]________________________

That’s it for today. Go forth, and shred things up, young ones!

From PDD - Dark Lord of Lewd[/h1]

notes.title: It's saucy time! - Dev Blog #2
notes.notes:
[h1]Greetings, fellow men of culture (and ladies)! [/h1]
It’s me again, back with the monthly saucy time. An extremely busy time of the year, but I have loads to update you on as the demo will be arriving in no time at all. 

As usual, I will be answering questions down in the comment section! Be sure to show your love to Kajun-chan too. She is super thrilled about saucy time. 

A close up of Kajun-chan, for your… [i]inspiration[/i] ( ͡° ͜ʖ ͡°), We are working on a series of cut-scenes for the demo that will also be featuring quite a few sexy closeup moments of our Kajun.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/e76f9a7930a93d4cb8bc74587fa38d9a6a0411f0.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/2f2ccd4b49648504ff4a91ed7a3e8d2c0a6f9318.gif[/img]

[h1]Art & Model[/h1]
[h2]Kajun-chan ingame 3D model development[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/63499f053f611fa386a5eb9fef62bbd027911217.png[/img]

Kajun-chan was once a highschool girl living the best time of her life on Earth, until the Tentamon took over. She was captured, weaponized, and eventually, mutated into our mecha girl. How will she escape the TEABAG’s base camp? With those giant metal claws? It’s very much up to us to control her throughout the battle.  

The in-game 3D model of Kajun-chan was intimately made down to the very small details, which required a huge effort from the team to make it all work and playable in-game. I put a lot of thought into each movement and feature so that the overall experience will be fluid, yet powerful to the player, hoping that she’ll impress you guys (●´ω｀●)

[h2]Battle concept[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/62edefc30db458cb7bd9540814751daa079d120d.jpg[/img]

In the early stages of the game, many have raised the question of “Why sexy and gory?”. They haven’t seen the gory side of Shred & Tear’s main dish yet! Be really open-minded, there will be blood to shed. Kajun-chan is merciless to these Tentamon! She'll be tearing these guys apart literally! 

Tentamons look cute, but they are actually rather [i]hideous[/i] and annoying! (*´Д｀*)

[h2]Kajun-chan high poly sculpt[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/cc79e368b89df0d504814896ecaa452870a70214.jpg[/img]

Kajun-chan simply deserves as many showcases as she wants. To do what? Those body-ody-ody, those bio-machines? They all need to be shown off. I personally wouldn’t stop making sculptures of her if I had the time. [b]She is the queen of mecha waifu![/b] ╰(*´︶`*)╯♡

The model was hand-sculpted using ZBrush & Maya.

[h2]Tentamon Builder Drone Model[/h2]

[previewyoutube=nMpZa0t2Xsg;full][/previewyoutube]

From 2D to in-game 3D model. Again, Tentamons look really cute and harmless, but you have no idea what they and their species are capable of. 
[olist]
[*] They took over our homeland - Earth 
[*] They are a hundred years AHEAD of us in warfare technology.
[*] Everything to them is simply either one of two things: Weapon or Bio-Energy Soup.
[/olist]
Repeat, Tentamons are hideous!

[h2]Kajun-chan was captured[/h2]

[previewyoutube=pJ-KBBDE3NA;full][/previewyoutube]

Being held captive and turned into a deadly weapon in a nefarious plot by the Tentamons, Kajun-chan’s hands are tied…She is extremely determined to get out, using the Tentamons’ technology against them! But she’ll need your help, get ready for her, and for the sake of this planet.

[h2]Hatching chamber[/h2]

[previewyoutube=IlUZzmKOpZc;full][/previewyoutube]

Built in UE4, this is the chamber where Tentamons store their experiments, and where Kajun-chan is held. What’s better than to hit them from the inside?

Yes. Not just Kajun-chan, the Tentamons took every living creature at their best lives, to capture, to experiment on. It is called the “hatching chamber” for a reason. It is the place where evil is hatched in the form of bio-weaponized human beings. The good news is that our Kajun-chan is one of the most powerful bio-weapons ever created by the Tentamon to date. 

[h2]Salumon MK II model[/h2]

[previewyoutube=I1SvooIPskk;full][/previewyoutube]

Inspired by some legends, the Salumon MK II’s concept is the demonstration of the first level gate boss. We’ve received a wide variety of responses from the community. Some said Mother Brain is the biological mother, some mentioned the Wall of Flesh as the twinsie ✌︎('ω')✌︎ what do you think?

The Demo version will probably have one level with about 20 minutes of gameplay, are you excited to see Salumon at the very end? No one has gotten past it, will Kajun-chan be the first to?

[h2]Squalomon[/h2]

[previewyoutube=INnqbhjKA2E;full][/previewyoutube]

Introducing another boss, and this one is definitely rated as one of the most aggressive enemies in Shred & Tear. Unlike Salumon, this one will move, this one will hunt. It thirsts for blood and definitely is merciless. Kajun-chan must take her claws to maximum capacity, no other choice.

Speed, accuracy, and fearlessness are definitely needed! Will you have enough adrenaline to face it? I’ll save that one for later.

[h1]Animation[/h1]
[h2]Kajun-chan claws[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/fcd3ed133cc454165c88711d4d86cda79ce7e15a.gif[/img]

A small interview with Kajun-chan:

Interviewer: Hi Kajun, what exactly is the purpose of those claws?
Kajun-chan: I’ll shred anything (or anyone) to tears *evil smile*

She’s a hot-tempered Aries with a fistful of ten deadly blades. She is not joking. Σ（ﾟдﾟlll）

[h1]Programming[/h1]
[h2]Kajun-chan Attack Combo [/h2]

[previewyoutube=tXwL4euYRKM;full][/previewyoutube]

As the Demo version is coming up really soon, Kajun-chan will be in such a rush to get her moves mastered. Of course with those giant claws, she’ll have to optimize the swing, making sure the Tentamons are shredded like minced meat. She plans to show no mercy at all! She’s got to be ready for the big three-course meal of these tentacles!

[h2]Auto-targeting system[/h2]

[previewyoutube=M8aeR7u56F4;full][/previewyoutube]

I originally tagged Shred & Tear as a hack n slash and fast-paced game. This ultimately ensures a non-stop and very forward-moving gameplay. While getting this in the middle of the battle, I thought it might slow the whole pace down. What do you think? It can be more precise, but it has a big effect on strategy and gameplay too.

[h2]Burst Attack [/h2]

[previewyoutube=TyntICtN5-4;full][/previewyoutube]

Kajun-chan is … gorgeous, and she’ll get things done in her own fashion!! The burst attack can be listed among her most aggressive moves on the Tentamons, ever. One slash, and a dozen of them are taken down. The spin is extra eye-candy… wait, not extra at all, Kajun is just being just the way she is! 

________________________

[h1]That’s it for today. Go forth, and shred things up, young ones!

From PDD - Dark Lord of Lewd[/h1]

notes.title: It's saucy time! - Dev Blog #1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/72a67611b5d379499841611c6265b1158e1bc67f.jpg[/img]
[b]Hello men of culture (and ladies)! [/b]

[h2]Happy New Year to you all! Have a blast and saucy upcoming year ✌︎('ω')✌︎[/h2]

As much as I am excited about getting some off time during the holiday season, it’s 2022 and the Demo release date comes ever closer, I will be keeping you guys updated through this series of saucy time. 

I have been working on this Shred & Tear “full-course menu” for almost a year now. The starters should be ready to serve soon, let’s get the table set, and I will be answering all of your burning questions in the comment section!

[previewyoutube=yElMk-aujss;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]The Store Page is Up![/h1]

After months of ghost development, I have finally set up a Steam store page. Everything is just [i]placeholder[/i] at the moment… except for the Logo and title!

I have put up almost everything we’ve got so far, so that you can have a good idea of what the game will be about, so hopefully we will have your attention from now on! [b]Please follow and support our little game, that would be super awesome! [/b]

Yes Shred & Tear is all about Hack n' Slash, gore, tentacles, and [i][b]boobies[/b][/i]! 
If that‘s your kink then please add it to your Steam wishlist (* ≧ ω ≦ *) !

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/d63080460b3d194267f7a664b62c78c9dd3286e9.png[/img]

[h1]Art & Model[/h1]
[h2]Decided on the name and finished Shred & Tear logo[/h2]
Being the [i]biggest fan[/i] of DOOM Eternal, I can’t deny that it’s the main source of inspiration. All of the gory bits combine with my own passion for lewdness – [b]et voilà![/b] Shred & Tear, with sexy mecha waifu tearing through bloody battles.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/cb2ae4783ca41a55497a8e74a596ab4bdbf14559.png[/img]

[previewyoutube=Bp8ifQf4YZk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]First look at Kajun-chan - The close-up and a demo of a trailer[/h2]
Kajun-chan is our protagonist, the “[i]sauce[/i]”, if you will. She is fiery and hot-blooded like her name, and is by no means just a side dish but a mouthful of a main course with extra thick seasoning!

When the Earth was invaded by the TEABAG empire of Tentamon, like many others in their ripe youth, Kajun was taken captive and turned into a deadly weapon of destruction. The more aggressive one individual is, the more powerful they will become as a weapon. While this may come across as silly, it’s actually rather brutal. 

With big Cajun claws and heavy metal armor, Kajun-chan is all about tough business. That she’s an Aries certainly helps, there’s no joking about their searing-hot temper.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/fe8662a1fd685c62ecbc31f88e2b0967f07f5abe.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522540/f04a89a2ac3e5a5f81f4e70770ef8349648268f4.gif[/img]

[h2]The little evil with tentacles - but in a cutie squishy form[/h2]
The [b]TEABAG[/b] (Tentamon Enslaved & Astronautic Bio Armed Galactica), may give you a chuckle at first, but they are pure condensed evil, that’s a fact! Tentamon is a [i]highly advanced race of tentacle[/i] monsters that conquer planets to harvest organic matter and transform local lifeforms into weaponry. They might look cute and unassuming, but like a mundane chili, appearances can be deceiving: [i]their brutal acts are not cute[/i], to no extent. All that they want under their (cute!) stubby tentacles are slavery and destruction!
